Examples of third-party devices are: network interfaces, video acquisition devices, storage adapters.\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is available on both Tesla and Quadro GPUs.\\\\nA number of limitations can apply, the most important being that the two devices must share the same upstream PCI Express root complex. Some of the limitations depend on the platform used and could be lifted in current/future products.\\\\nA few straightforward changes must be made to device drivers to enable this functionality with a wide range of hardware devices. This document introduces the technology and describes the steps necessary to enable an GPUDirect RDMA connection to NVIDIA GPUs on Linux.\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA within the Linux Device Driver Model\\\\n\\\\n1.1.\\\\nHow GPUDirect RDMA Works\\\\n\\\\nWhen setting up GPUDirect RDMA communication between two peers, all physical addresses are the same from the PCI Express devices’ point of view. Within this physical address space are linear windows called PCI BARs. Each device has six BAR registers at most, so it can have up to six active 32bit BAR regions. 64bit BARs consume two BAR registers. The PCI Express device issues reads and writes to a peer device’s BAR addresses in the same way that they are issued to system memory.\\\\nTraditionally, resources like BAR windows are mapped to user or kernel address space using the CPU’s MMU as memory mapped I/O (MMIO) addresses. However, because current operating systems don’t have sufficient mechanisms for exchanging MMIO regions between drivers, the NVIDIA kernel driver exports functions to perform the necessary address translations and mappings.\\\\nTo add GPUDirect RDMA support to a device driver, a small amount of address mapping code within the kernel driver must be modified. This code typically resides near existing calls to\\\\nget_user_pages()\\\\n.\\\\nThe APIs and control flow involved with GPUDirect RDMA are very similar to those used with standard DMA transfers.\\\\nRefer to\\\\nSupported Systems\\\\nand\\\\nPCI BAR sizes\\\\nfor more hardware details.\\\\n1.2.\\\\nStandard DMA Transfer\\\\n\\\\nFirst, we outline a standard DMA Transfer initiated from userspace. In this scenario, the following components are present:\\\\nUserspace program\\\\nUserspace communication library\\\\nKernel driver for the device interested in doing DMA transfers\\\\nThe general sequence is as follows:\\\\nThe userspace program requests a transfer via the userspace communication library. This operation takes a pointer to data (a virtual address) and a size in bytes.\\\\nThe communication library must make sure the memory region corresponding to the virtual address and size is ready for the transfer. If this is not the case already, it has to be handled by the kernel driver (next step).\\\\nThe kernel driver receives the virtual address and size from the userspace communication library. It then asks the kernel to translate the virtual address range to a list of physical pages and make sure they are ready to be transferred to or from. We will refer to this operation as pinning the memory.\\\\nThe kernel driver uses the list of pages to program the physical device’s DMA engine(s).\\\\nThe communication library initiates the transfer.\\\\nAfter the transfer is done, the communication library should eventually clean up any resources used to pin the memory. We will refer to this operation as unpinning the memory.\\\\n1.3.\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA Transfers\\\\n\\\\nFor the communication to support GPUDirect RDMA transfers some changes to the sequence above have to be introduced. First of all, two new components are present:\\\\nUserspace CUDA library\\\\nNVIDIA kernel driver\\\\nAs described in\\\\nBasics of UVA CUDA Memory Management\\\\n, programs using the CUDA library have their address space split between GPU and CPU virtual addresses, and the communication library has to implement two separate paths for them.\\\\nThe userspace CUDA library provides a function that lets the communication library distinguish between CPU and GPU addresses. Moreover, for GPU addresses it returns additional metadata that is required to uniquely identify the GPU memory represented by the address. Refer to\\\\nUserspace API\\\\nfor details.\\\\nThe difference between the paths for CPU and GPU addresses is in how the memory is pinned and unpinned. For CPU memory this is handled by built-in Linux Kernel functions (\\\\nget_user_pages()\\\\nand\\\\nput_page()\\\\n). However, in the GPU memory case the pinning and unpinning has to be handled by functions provided by the NVIDIA Kernel driver. See\\\\nPinning GPU memory\\\\nand\\\\nUnpinning GPU memory\\\\nfor details.\\\\nSome hardware caveats are explained in\\\\nSupported Systems\\\\nand\\\\nPCI BAR sizes\\\\n.\\\\n1.4.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 6.0\\\\n\\\\nIn this section we briefly list the changes that are available in CUDA 6.0:\\\\nCUDA peer-to-peer tokens are no longer mandatory. For memory buffers owned by the calling process (which is typical) tokens can be replaced by zero (0) in the kernel-mode function\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\n. This new feature is meant to make it easier for existing third party software stacks to adopt RDMA for GPUDirect.\\\\nAs a consequence of the change above, a new API\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute()\\\\nhas been introduced. This API must be used to register any buffer for which no peer-to-peer tokens are used. It is necessary to ensure correct synchronization behavior of the CUDA API when operation on memory which may be read by RDMA for GPUDirect. Failing to use it in these cases may cause data corruption. See changes in\\\\nTokens Usage\\\\n.\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nhas been extended to return a globally unique numeric identifier, which in turn can be used by lower-level libraries to detect buffer reallocations happening in user-level code (Refer to\\\\nUserspace API\\\\n). It provides an alternative method to detect reallocations when intercepting CUDA allocation and deallocation APIs is not possible.\\\\nThe kernel-mode memory pinning feature has been extended to work in combination with Multi-Process Service (MPS).\\\\nCaveats as of CUDA 6.0:\\\\nCUDA Unified Memory is not explicitly supported in combination with GPUDirect RDMA. While the page table returned by\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\nis valid for managed memory buffers and provides a mapping of GPU memory at any given moment in time, the GPU device copy of that memory may be incoherent with the writable copy of the page which is not on the GPU. Using the page table in this circumstance may result in accessing stale data, or data loss, because of a DMA write access to device memory that is subsequently overwritten by the Unified Memory run-time.\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nmay be used to determine if an address is being managed by the Unified Memory runtime.\\\\nEvery time a device memory region is pinned, new GPU BAR space is allocated unconditionally, even when pinning overlapping or duplicate device memory ranges, i.e. there is no attempt at reusing mappings. This behavior has been changed since CUDA 7.0.\\\\n1.5.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 7.0\\\\n\\\\nIn this section we briefly list the changes that are available in CUDA 7.0:\\\\nOn the IBM POWER8 platform, GPUDirect RDMA is not supported, though it is not explicitly disabled.\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is not guaranteed to work on any given ARM64 platform.\\\\nManagement of GPU BAR mappings has been improved with respect to CUDA 6.0. Now when a device memory region is pinned, GPU BAR space might be shared with pre-existing mappings. This is the case for example when pinning overlapping or duplicate device memory ranges. As a consequence, when unpinning a region, its whole BAR space will not be returned if even only a subset of its BAR space is shared.\\\\nThe new\\\\ncuPointerGetAttributes()\\\\nAPI has been introduced. It can be useful when retrieving multiple attributes for the same buffer, e.g. in MPI when examining a new buffer.\\\\ncudaPointerGetAttributes()\\\\nis now faster since it leverages\\\\ncuPointerGetAttributes()\\\\ninternally.\\\\nA new sample code,\\\\nsamples/7_CUDALibraries/cuHook\\\\n, has been added in CUDA 6.5. It can be used as a template for implementing an interception framework for CUDA memory de/allocation APIs.\\\\n1.6.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 8.0\\\\n\\\\nIn this section we briefly list the changes that are available in CUDA 8.0:\\\\nThe nvidia_p2p_page_table struct has been extended to include a new member, without breaking binary compatibility. The minor version in the NVIDIA_P2P_PAGE_TABLE_VERSION macro has been updated accordingly.\\\\nThe\\\\nnvidia_p2p_dma_mapping\\\\nstructure, the\\\\nnvidia_p2p_dma_map_pages()\\\\nand\\\\nnvidia_p2p_dma_unmap_pages()\\\\nAPIs, the\\\\nNVIDIA_P2P_DMA_MAPPING_VERSION\\\\nmacro have been introduced. These APIs can be used by third party device drivers to map and unmap the GPU BAR pages into their device’s I/O address space. The main use case is on platforms where the I/O addresses of PCIe resources, used for PCIe peer-to-peer transactions, are different from the physical addresses used by the CPU to access those same resources. See this\\\\nlink\\\\nfor an example of code using these new APIs.\\\\nThe\\\\nNVIDIA_P2P_PAGE_TABLE_VERSION_COMPATIBLE\\\\nand\\\\nNVIDIA_P2P_DMA_MAPPING_VERSION_COMPATIBLE\\\\nmacros have been introduced. These are meant to be called by third-party device drivers to check for runtime binary compatibility, for example in case of changes to the data structure’s layout.\\\\nOn the IBM POWER8 platform, when using the above APIs, GPUDirect RDMA is reported to work correctly restricted to the case where the GPU and the third party device are connected through a supported PCIe switch.\\\\n1.7.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 10.1\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is supported on Jetson AGX Xavier platform. Refer to the\\\\nPorting to Tegra\\\\nsection for details.\\\\n1.8.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 11.2\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is supported on Drive AGX Xavier Linux based platform. Refer to the\\\\nPorting to Tegra\\\\nsection for details.\\\\n1.9.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 11.4\\\\n\\\\nAdded a new a kernel module,\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\n, which provides Mellanox InfiniBand-based HCAs (Host Channel Adapters) direct peer-to-peer read and write access to the NVIDIA GPU’s video memory. Refer to\\\\nUsing nvidia-peermem\\\\nfor details.\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is supported on Jetson Orin platform. Refer to the\\\\nPorting to Tegra\\\\nsection for details.\\\\nKnown Issue:\\\\nCurrently, there is no service to automatically load\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\n. Users need to load the module manually.\\\\n1.10.\\\\nChanges in CUDA 12.2\\\\n\\\\nIn drivers released from the R515 up to the R535 branches, except for newer R525 and R535 releases mentioned below, there is a race bug which may show up as a kernel null-pointer dereference. This happens when the GPU invokes the (hereby I/O) kernel driver invalidation callback, the one which was registered during the call to\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages\\\\n, concurrently with the I/O driver calling\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages\\\\n.\\\\nThe race bug does not affect the persistent mapping case, as in that case an invalidation callback is not supported nor needed.\\\\nThe bug fix required the following API change:\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages\\\\nno longer accepts a NULL callback pointer.\\\\nInstead,\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages_persistent\\\\nand\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages_persistent\\\\nhave been introduced and should be used instead when requesting a persistent mapping.\\\\nThe use of those new persistent APIs can be guarded by the\\\\nNVIDIA_P2P_CAP_GET_PAGES_PERSISTENT_API\\\\npreprocessor macro, for example when writing portable drivers.\\\\nThe\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\nkernel module has been updated accordingly.\\\\nAlthough deprecated when running GPU drivers from the R470 branch and newer, customers still using the off-tree\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\nmodule\\\\n(\\\\nhttps://github.com/Mellanox/nv_peer_memory\\\\n) and needing the persistent mapping feature will have to switch to\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\n.\\\\nNote that I/O drivers, which do not need persistent mappings, do not require source code changes.\\\\nThe API changes described above are deployed in the R535 branch, specifically in release 535.14 and later, and have also been back-ported to the R525 branch, for TeslaRD3 (525.105.17) and later.\\\\n2.\\\\nDesign Considerations\\\\n\\\\nWhen designing a system to utilize GPUDirect RDMA, there a number of considerations which should be taken into account.\\\\n2.1.\\\\nLazy Unpinning Optimization\\\\n\\\\nPinning GPU device memory in BAR is an expensive operation, taking up to milliseconds. Therefore the application should be designed in a way to minimize that overhead.\\\\nThe most straightforward implementation using GPUDirect RDMA would pin memory before each transfer and unpin it right after the transfer is complete. Unfortunately, this would perform poorly in general, as pinning and unpinning memory are expensive operations. The rest of the steps required to perform an RDMA transfer, however, can be performed quickly without entering the kernel (the DMA list can be cached and replayed using MMIO registers/command lists).\\\\nHence, lazily unpinning memory is key to a high performance RDMA implementation. What it implies, is keeping the memory pinned even after the transfer has finished. This takes advantage of the fact that it is likely that the same memory region will be used for future DMA transfers thus lazy unpinning saves pin/unpin operations.\\\\nAn example implementation of lazy unpinning would keep a set of pinned memory regions and only unpin some of them (for example the least recently used one) if the total size of the regions reached some threshold, or if pinning a new region failed because of BAR space exhaustion (refer to\\\\nPCI BAR sizes\\\\n).\\\\n2.2.\\\\nRegistration Cache\\\\n\\\\nCommunication middleware often employs an optimization called a registration cache, or pin-down cache, to minimize pinning overhead. Typically it already exists for host memory, implementing lazy unpinning, LRU de-registration, etc. For networking middleware, such caches are usually implemented in user-space, as they are used in combination with hardware capable of user-mode message injection. CUDA UVA memory address layout enables GPU memory pinning to work with these caches by taking into account just a few design considerations. In the CUDA environment, this is even more important as the amount of memory which can be pinned may be significantly more constrained than for host memory.\\\\nAs the GPU BAR space is typically mapped using 64KB pages, it is more resource efficient to maintain a cache of regions rounded to the 64KB boundary. Even more so, as two memory areas which are in the same 64KB boundary would allocate and return the same BAR mapping.\\\\nRegistration caches usually rely on the ability to intercept deallocation events happening in the user application, so that they can unpin the memory and free important HW resources, e.g. on the network card. To implement a similar mechanism for GPU memory, an implementation has two options:\\\\nInstrument all CUDA allocation and deallocation APIs.\\\\nUse a tag check function to track deallocation and reallocation. Refer to\\\\nBuffer ID Tag Check for A Registration Cache\\\\n.\\\\nThere is a sample application,\\\\n7_CUDALibraries/cuHook\\\\n, showing how to intercept calls to CUDA APIs at run-time, which can be used to detect GPU memory de/allocations.\\\\nWhile intercepting CUDA APIs is beyond the scope of this document, an approach to performing tag checks is available starting with CUDA 6.0. It involves the usage of the\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\nattribute in\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\n(or\\\\ncuPointerGetAttributes()\\\\nif more attributes are needed) to detect memory buffer deallocations or reallocations. The API will return a different ID value in case of reallocation or an error if the buffer address is no longer valid. Refer to\\\\nUserspace API\\\\nfor API usage.\\\\nNote\\\\nUsing tag checks introduces an extra call into the CUDA API on each memory buffer use, so this approach is most appropriate when the additional latency is not a concern.\\\\n2.3.\\\\nUnpin Callback\\\\n\\\\nWhen a third party device driver pins the GPU pages with\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\nit must also provide a callback function that the NVIDIA driver will call if it needs to revoke access to the mapping.\\\\nThis callback occurs synchronously\\\\n, giving the third party driver the opportunity to clean up and remove any references to the pages in question (i.e., wait for outstanding DMAs to complete).\\\\nThe user callback function may block for a few milliseconds\\\\n, although it is recommended that the callback complete as quickly as possible. Care has to be taken not to introduce deadlocks as waiting within the callback for the GPU to do anything is not safe.\\\\nThe callback must call\\\\nnvidia_p2p_free_page_table()\\\\n(not\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\n) to free the memory pointed to by\\\\npage_table\\\\n. The corresponding mapped memory areas will only be unmapped by the NVIDIA driver after returning from the callback.\\\\nNote that the callback will be invoked in two scenarios:\\\\nIf the userspace program explicitly deallocates the corresponding GPU memory, e.g.\\\\ncuMemFree\\\\n,\\\\ncuCtxDestroy\\\\n, etc. before the third party kernel driver has a chance to unpin the memory with\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\n.\\\\nAs a consequence of an early exit of the process.\\\\nIn the latter case there can be tear-down ordering issues between closing the file descriptor of the third party kernel driver and that of the NVIDIA kernel driver. In the case the file descriptor for the NVIDIA kernel driver is closed first, the\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\ncallback will be invoked.\\\\nA proper software design is important as the NVIDIA kernel driver will protect itself from reentrancy issues with locks before invoking the callback. The third party kernel driver will almost certainly take similar actions, so dead-locking or live-locking scenarios may arise if careful consideration is not taken.\\\\n2.4.\\\\nSupported Systems\\\\n\\\\nGeneral remarks\\\\nEven though the only theoretical requirement for GPUDirect RDMA to work between a third-party device and an NVIDIA GPU is that they share the same root complex, there exist bugs (mostly in chipsets) causing it to perform badly, or not work at all in certain setups.\\\\nWe can distinguish between three situations, depending on what is on the path between the GPU and the third-party device:\\\\nPCIe switches only\\\\nsingle CPU/IOH\\\\nCPU/IOH <-> QPI/HT <-> CPU/IOH\\\\nThe first situation, where there are only PCIe switches on the path, is optimal and yields the best performance. The second one, where a single CPU/IOH is involved, works, but yields worse performance ( especially peer-to-peer read bandwidth has been shown to be severely limited on some processor architectures ). Finally, the third situation, where the path traverses a QPI/HT link, may be extremely performance-limited or even not work reliably.\\\\nTip\\\\nlspci can be used to check the PCI topology:\\\\n$\\\\nlspci\\\\n-\\\\nt\\\\nPlatform support\\\\nFor IBM POWER8 platform, GPUDirect RDMA and P2P are not supported, but are not explicitly disabled. They may not work at run-time.\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is supported on Jetson AGX Xavier platform starting from CUDA 10.1 and on Drive AGX Xavier Linux based platforms from CUDA 11.2. Refer to\\\\nPorting to Tegra\\\\nfor details. On ARM64, the necessary peer-to-peer functionality depends on both the hardware and the software of the particular platform. So while GPUDirect RDMA is not explicitly disabled on non-Jetson and non-Drive platforms, there are no guarantees that it will be fully functional.\\\\nIOMMUs\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA currently relies upon all physical addresses being the same from the different PCI devices’ point of view. This makes it incompatible with IOMMUs performing any form of translation other than 1:1, hence they must be disabled or configured for pass-through translation for GPUDirect RDMA to work.\\\\n2.5.\\\\nPCI BAR sizes\\\\n\\\\nPCI devices can ask the OS/BIOS to map a region of physical address space to them. These regions are commonly called BARs. NVIDIA GPUs currently expose multiple BARs, and some of them can back arbitrary device memory, making GPUDirect RDMA possible.\\\\nThe maximum BAR size available for GPUDirect RDMA differs from GPU to GPU. For example, currently the smallest available BAR size on Kepler class GPUs is 256 MB. Of that, 32MB are currently reserved for internal use. These sizes may change.\\\\nOn some Tesla-class GPUs a large BAR feature is enabled, e.g. BAR1 size is set to 16GB or larger. Large BARs can pose a problem for the BIOS, especially on older motherbords, related to compatibility support for 32bit operating systems. On those motherboards the bootstrap can stop during the early POST phase, or the GPU may be misconfigured and so unusable. If this appears to be occuring it might be necessary to enable some special BIOS feature to deal with the large BAR issue. Please consult your system vendor for more details regarding large BAR support.\\\\n2.6.\\\\nTokens Usage\\\\n\\\\nWarning\\\\nStarting in CUDA 6.0, tokens should be considered deprecated, though they are still supported.\\\\nAs can be seen in\\\\nUserspace API\\\\nand\\\\nKernel API\\\\n, one method for pinning and unpinning memory requires two tokens in addition to the GPU virtual address.\\\\nThese tokens,\\\\np2pToken\\\\nand\\\\nvaSpaceToken\\\\n, are necessary to uniquely identify a GPU VA space. A process identifier alone does not identify a GPU VA space.\\\\nThe tokens are consistent within a single CUDA context (i.e., all memory obtained through\\\\ncudaMalloc()\\\\nwithin the same CUDA context will have the same\\\\np2pToken\\\\nand\\\\nvaSpaceToken\\\\n). However, a given GPU virtual address need not map to the same context/GPU for its entire lifetime. As a concrete example:\\\\ncudaSetDevice\\\\n(\\\\n0\\\\n)\\\\nptr0\\\\n=\\\\ncudaMalloc\\\\n();\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\nreturn_data\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\n,\\\\nptr0\\\\n);\\\\n// Returns [p2pToken = 0xabcd, vaSpaceToken = 0x1]\\\\ncudaFree\\\\n(\\\\nptr0\\\\n);\\\\ncudaSetDevice\\\\n(\\\\n1\\\\n);\\\\nptr1\\\\n=\\\\ncudaMalloc\\\\n();\\\\nassert\\\\n(\\\\nptr0\\\\n==\\\\nptr1\\\\n);\\\\n// The CUDA driver is free (although not guaranteed) to reuse the VA,\\\\n// even on a different GPU\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\nreturn_data\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\n,\\\\nptr0\\\\n);\\\\n// Returns [p2pToken = 0x0123, vaSpaceToken = 0x2]\\\\nThat is, the same address, when passed to\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n, may return different tokens at different times during the program’s execution. Therefore, the third party communication library must call\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nfor every pointer it operates on.\\\\nSecurity implications\\\\nThe two tokens act as an authentication mechanism for the NVIDIA kernel driver. If you know the tokens, you can map the address space corresponding to them, and the NVIDIA kernel driver doesn’t perform any additional checks. The 64bit\\\\np2pToken\\\\nis randomized to prevent it from being guessed by an adversary.\\\\nWhen no tokens are used, the NVIDIA driver limits the\\\\nKernel API\\\\nto the process which owns the memory allocation.\\\\n2.7.\\\\nSynchronization and Memory Ordering\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA introduces a new independent GPU data flow path exposed to third party devices and it is important to understand how these devices interact with the GPU’s relaxed memory model.\\\\nProperly registering a BAR mapping of CUDA memory is required for that mapping to remain consistent with CUDA APIs operations on that memory.\\\\nOnly CUDA synchronization and work submission APIs provide memory ordering of GPUDirect RDMA operations.\\\\nRegistration for CUDA API Consistency\\\\nRegistration is necessary to ensure the CUDA API memory operations visible to a BAR mapping happen before the API call returns control to the calling CPU thread. This provides a consistent view of memory to a device using GPUDirect RDMA mappings when invoked after a CUDA API in the thread. This is a strictly more conservative mode of operation for the CUDA API and disables optimizations, thus it may negatively impact performance.\\\\nThis behavior is enabled on a per-allocation granularity either by calling\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute()\\\\nwith the\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_SYNC_MEMOPS\\\\nattribute, or p2p tokens are retrieved for a buffer when using the legacy path. Refer to\\\\nUserspace API\\\\nfor more details.\\\\nAn example situation would be Read-after-Write dependency between a\\\\ncuMemcpyDtoD()\\\\nand subsequent GPUDirect RDMA read operation on the destination of the copy. As an optimization the device-to-device memory copy typically returns asynchronously to the calling thread after queuing the copy to the GPU scheduler. However, in this circumstance that will lead to inconsistent data read via the BAR mapping, so this optimization is disabled an the copy completed before the CUDA API returns.\\\\nCUDA APIs for Memory Ordering\\\\nOnly CPU initiated CUDA APIs provide ordering of GPUDirect memory operations as observed by the GPU. That is, despite a third party device having issued all PCIE transactions, a running GPU kernel or copy operation may observe stale data or data that arrives out-of-order until a subsequent CPU initiated CUDA work submission or synchronization API. To ensure that memory updates are visible to CUDA kernels or copies, an implementation should ensure that all writes to the GPU BAR happen before control is returned to the CPU thread which will invoke the dependent CUDA API.\\\\nAn example situation for a network communication scenario is when a network RDMA write operation is completed by the third party network device and the data is written to the GPU BAR mapping. Though reading back the written data either through GPU BAR or a CUDA memory copy operation, will return the newly written data, a concurrently running GPU kernel to that network write might observe stale data, the data partially written, or the data written out-of-order.\\\\nIn short, a GPU kernel is wholly inconsistent with concurrent RDMA for GPUDirect operations and accessing the memory overwritten by the third party device in such a situation would be considered a data race. To resolve this inconsistency and remove the data race the DMA write operation must complete with respect to the CPU thread which will launch the dependent GPU kernel.\\\\n3.\\\\nHow to Perform Specific Tasks\\\\n\\\\n3.1.\\\\nDisplaying GPU BAR space\\\\n\\\\nStarting in CUDA 6.0 the NVIDIA SMI utility provides the capability to dump BAR1 memory usage. It can be used to understand the application usage of BAR space, the primary resource consumed by GPUDirect RDMA mappings.\\\\n$ nvidia-smi -q\\\\n...\\\\n      BAR1 Memory Usage\\\\n         Total                       : 256 MiB\\\\n         Used                        : 2 MiB\\\\n         Free                        : 254 MiB\\\\n...\\\\nGPU memory is pinned in fixed size chunks, so the amount of space reflected here might be unexpected. In addition, a certain amount of BAR space is reserved by the driver for internal use, so not all available memory may be usable via GPUDirect RDMA. Note that the same ability is offered programmatically through the\\\\nnvmlDeviceGetBAR1MemoryInfo()\\\\nNVML API.\\\\n3.2.\\\\nPinning GPU memory\\\\n\\\\nCorrect behavior requires using\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute()\\\\non the memory address to enable proper synchronization behavior in the CUDA driver. Refer to\\\\nSynchronization and Memory Ordering\\\\n.\\\\nvoid\\\\npin_buffer\\\\n(\\\\nvoid\\\\n*\\\\naddress\\\\n,\\\\nsize_t\\\\nsize\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nflag\\\\n=\\\\n1\\\\n;\\\\nCUresult\\\\nstatus\\\\n=\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\nflag\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_SYNC_MEMOPS\\\\n,\\\\naddress\\\\n);\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nCUDA_SUCCESS\\\\n==\\\\nstatus\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// GPU path\\\\npass_to_kernel_driver\\\\n(\\\\naddress\\\\n,\\\\nsize\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\nelse\\\\n{\\\\n// CPU path\\\\n// ...\\\\n}\\\\n}\\\\nThis is required so that the GPU memory buffer is treated in a special way by the CUDA driver, so that CUDA memory transfers are guaranteed to always be synchronous with respect to the host. Refer to\\\\nUserspace API\\\\nfor details on\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute()\\\\n.\\\\nIn the kernel driver, invoke\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\n.\\\\n// for boundary alignment requirement\\\\n#define GPU_BOUND_SHIFT   16\\\\n#define GPU_BOUND_SIZE    ((u64)1 << GPU_BOUND_SHIFT)\\\\n#define GPU_BOUND_OFFSET  (GPU_BOUND_SIZE-1)\\\\n#define GPU_BOUND_MASK    (~GPU_BOUND_OFFSET)\\\\nstruct\\\\nkmd_state\\\\n{\\\\nnvidia_p2p_page_table_t\\\\n*\\\\npage_table\\\\n;\\\\n// ...\\\\n};\\\\nvoid\\\\nkmd_pin_memory\\\\n(\\\\nstruct\\\\nkmd_state\\\\n*\\\\nmy_state\\\\n,\\\\nvoid\\\\n*\\\\naddress\\\\n,\\\\nsize_t\\\\nsize\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// do proper alignment, as required by NVIDIA kernel driver\\\\nu64\\\\nvirt_start\\\\n=\\\\naddress\\\\n&\\\\nGPU_BOUND_MASK\\\\n;\\\\nsize_t\\\\npin_size\\\\n=\\\\n(\\\\naddress\\\\n+\\\\nsize\\\\n-\\\\nvirt_start\\\\n+\\\\nGPU_BOUND_SIZE\\\\n-\\\\n1\\\\n)\\\\n&\\\\nGPU_BOUND_MASK\\\\n;\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\n!\\\\nsize\\\\n)\\\\nreturn\\\\n-\\\\nEINVAL\\\\n;\\\\nint\\\\nret\\\\n=\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages\\\\n(\\\\n0\\\\n,\\\\n0\\\\n,\\\\nvirt_start\\\\n,\\\\npin_size\\\\n,\\\\n&\\\\nmy_state\\\\n->\\\\npage_table\\\\n,\\\\nfree_callback\\\\n,\\\\n&\\\\nmy_state\\\\n);\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nret\\\\n==\\\\n0\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// Succesfully pinned, page_table can be accessed\\\\n}\\\\nelse\\\\n{\\\\n// Pinning failed\\\\n}\\\\n}\\\\nNote how the start address is aligned to a 64KB boundary before calling the pinning functions.\\\\nIf the function succeeds the memory has been pinned and the\\\\npage_table\\\\nentries can be used to program the device’s DMA engine. Refer to\\\\nKernel API\\\\nfor details on\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\n.\\\\n3.3.\\\\nUnpinning GPU memory\\\\n\\\\nIn the kernel driver, invoke\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\n.\\\\nvoid\\\\nunpin_memory\\\\n(\\\\nvoid\\\\n*\\\\naddress\\\\n,\\\\nsize_t\\\\nsize\\\\n,\\\\nnvidia_p2p_page_table_t\\\\n*\\\\npage_table\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages\\\\n(\\\\n0\\\\n,\\\\n0\\\\n,\\\\naddress\\\\n,\\\\nsize\\\\n,\\\\npage_table\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\nRefer to\\\\nKernel API\\\\nfor details on\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\n.\\\\nStarting CUDA 6.0 zeros should be used as the token parameters. Note that\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\nmust be called from within the same process context as the one from which the corresponding\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\nhas been issued.\\\\n3.4.\\\\nHandling the free callback\\\\n\\\\nThe NVIDIA kernel driver invokes\\\\nfree_callback(data)\\\\nas specified in the\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\ncall if it needs to revoke the mapping. Refer to\\\\nKernel API\\\\nand\\\\nUnpin Callback\\\\nfor details.\\\\nThe callback waits for pending transfers and then cleans up the page table allocation.\\\\nvoid\\\\nfree_callback\\\\n(\\\\nvoid\\\\n*\\\\ndata\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nmy_state\\\\n*\\\\nstate\\\\n=\\\\ndata\\\\n;\\\\nwait_for_pending_transfers\\\\n(\\\\nstate\\\\n);\\\\nnvidia_p2p_free_pages\\\\n(\\\\nstate\\\\n->\\\\npage_table\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\nThe NVIDIA kernel driver handles the unmapping so\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\nshould not be called.\\\\n3.5.\\\\nBuffer ID Tag Check for A Registration Cache\\\\n\\\\nRemember that a solution built around Buffer ID tag checking is not recommended for latency sensitive implementations. Instead, instrumentation of CUDA allocation and deallocation APIs to provide callbacks to the registration cache is recommended, removing tag checking overhead from the critical path.\\\\nThe first time a device memory buffer is encountered and recognized as not yet pinned, the pinned mapping is created and the associated buffer ID is retrieved and stored together in the cache entry. The\\\\ncuMemGetAddressRange()\\\\nfunction can be used to obtain the size and starting address for the whole allocation, which can then be used to pin it. As\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\nwill need a pointer aligned to 64K, it is useful to directly align the cached address. Also, as the BAR space is currently mapped in chunks of 64KB, it is more resource efficient to round the whole pinning to 64KB.\\\\n// struct buf represents an entry of the registration cache\\\\nstruct\\\\nbuf\\\\n{\\\\nCUdeviceptr\\\\npointer\\\\n;\\\\nsize_t\\\\nsize\\\\n;\\\\nCUdeviceptr\\\\naligned_pointer\\\\n;\\\\nsize_t\\\\naligned_size\\\\n;\\\\nint\\\\nis_pinned\\\\n;\\\\nuint64_t\\\\nid\\\\n;\\\\n// buffer id obtained right after pinning\\\\n};\\\\nOnce created, every time a registration cache entry will be used it must be first checked for validity. One way to do this is to use the Buffer ID provided by CUDA as a tag to check for deallocation or reallocation.\\\\nint\\\\nbuf_is_gpu_pinning_valid\\\\n(\\\\nstruct\\\\nbuf\\\\n*\\\\nbuf\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\nuint64_t\\\\nbuffer_id\\\\n;\\\\nint\\\\nretcode\\\\n;\\\\nassert\\\\n(\\\\nbuf\\\\n->\\\\nis_pinned\\\\n);\\\\n// get the current buffer id\\\\nretcode\\\\n=\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\nbuffer_id\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\n,\\\\nbuf\\\\n->\\\\npointer\\\\n);\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nCUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE\\\\n==\\\\nretcode\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// the device pointer is no longer valid\\\\n// it could have been deallocated\\\\nreturn\\\\nERROR_INVALIDATED\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\nelse\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nCUDA_SUCCESS\\\\n!=\\\\nretcode\\\\n)\\\\n{\\\\n// handle more serious errors here\\\\nreturn\\\\nERROR_SERIOUS\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nbuf\\\\n->\\\\nid\\\\n!=\\\\nbuffer_id\\\\n)\\\\n// the original buffer has been deallocated and the cached mapping should be invalidated and the buffer re-pinned\\\\nreturn\\\\nERROR_INVALIDATED\\\\n;\\\\nreturn\\\\n0\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\nWhen the buffer identifier changes the corresponding memory buffer has been reallocated so the corresponding kernel-space page table will not be valid anymore. In this case the kernel-space\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\ncallback would have been invoked. Thus the Buffer IDs provide a tag to keep the pin-down cache consistent with the kernel-space page table without requiring the kernel driver to up-call into the user-space.\\\\nIf\\\\nCUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE\\\\nis returned from\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\n, the program should assume that the memory buffer has been deallocated or is otherwise not a valid GPU memory buffer.\\\\nIn both cases, the corresponding cache entry must be invalidated.\\\\n// in the registration cache code\\\\nif\\\\n(\\\\nbuf\\\\n->\\\\nis_pinned\\\\n&&\\\\n!\\\\nbuf_is_gpu_pinning_valid\\\\n(\\\\nbuf\\\\n))\\\\n{\\\\nregcache_invalidate_entry\\\\n(\\\\nbuf\\\\n);\\\\npin_buffer\\\\n(\\\\nbuf\\\\n);\\\\n}\\\\n3.6.\\\\nLinking a Kernel Module against nvidia.ko\\\\n\\\\nRun the extraction script:\\\\n./NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-<version>.run -x\\\\nThis extracts the NVIDA driver and kernel wrapper.\\\\nNavigate to the output directory:\\\\ncd <output directory>/kernel/\\\\nWithin this directory, build the NVIDIA module for your kernel:\\\\nmake module\\\\nAfter this is done, the\\\\nModule.symvers\\\\nfile under your kernel build directory contains symbol information for\\\\nnvidia.ko\\\\n.\\\\nModify your kernel module build process with the following line:\\\\nKBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS := <path to kernel build directory>/Module.symvers\\\\n3.7.\\\\nUsing nvidia-peermem\\\\n\\\\nThe NVIDIA GPU driver package provides a kernel module,\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\n, which provides NVIDIA InfiniBand based HCAs (Host Channel Adapters) direct peer-to-peer read and write access to the NVIDIA GPU’s video memory. It allows GPUDirect RDMA-based applications to use GPU computing power with the RDMA interconnect without needing to copy data to host memory.\\\\nThis capability is supported with NVIDIA ConnectX®-3 VPI or newer adapters. It works with both InfiniBand and RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet) technologies.\\\\nNVIDIA OFED (Open Fabrics Enterprise Distribution), or MLNX_OFED, introduces an API between the InfiniBand Core and peer memory clients such as NVIDIA GPUs. The\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\nmodule registers the NVIDIA GPU with the InfiniBand subsystem by using peer-to-peer APIs provided by the NVIDIA GPU driver.\\\\nThe kernel must have the required support for RDMA peer memory either through additional patches to the kernel or via MLNX_OFED as a prerequisite for loading and using\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\n.\\\\nIt is possible that the\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\nmodule from the GitHub project may be installed and loaded on the system. Installation of\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\nwill not affect the functionality of the existing\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\nmodule. But, to load and use\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\n, users must disable the\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\nservice. Additionally, it is encouraged to uninstall the\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\npackage to avoid any conflict with\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\nsince only one module can be loaded at any time.\\\\nTo stop the\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\nservice:\\\\n# service nv_peer_mem stop</screen>\\\\nCheck if\\\\nnv_peer_mem.ko\\\\nis still loaded after stopping the service:\\\\n# lsmod | grep nv_peer_mem\\\\nIf\\\\nnv_peer_mem.ko\\\\nis still loaded, unload it using:\\\\n# rmmod nv_peer_mem\\\\nUninstall the\\\\nnv_peer_mem\\\\npackage:\\\\nFor DEB-based OS:\\\\n# dpkg -P nvidia-peer-memory\\\\n# dpkg -P nvidia-peer-memory-dkms\\\\nFor RPM-based OS:\\\\n# rpm -e nvidia_peer_memory\\\\nAfter ensuring kernel support and installing the GPU driver,\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\ncan be loaded with the following command with root privileges in a terminal window:\\\\n# modprobe nvidia-peermem\\\\nNote\\\\nNote: If the NVIDIA GPU driver is installed before MLNX_OFED, the GPU driver must be uninstalled and installed again to make sure\\\\nnvidia-peermem\\\\nis compiled with the RDMA APIs that are provided by MLNX_OFED.\\\\n4.\\\\nReferences\\\\n\\\\n4.1.\\\\nBasics of UVA CUDA Memory Management\\\\n\\\\nUnified virtual addressing (UVA) is a memory address management system enabled by default in CUDA 4.0 and later releases on Fermi and Kepler GPUs running 64-bit processes. The design of UVA memory management provides a basis for the operation of GPUDirect RDMA. On UVA-supported configurations, when the CUDA runtime initializes, the virtual address (VA) range of the application is partitioned into two areas: the CUDA-managed VA range and the OS-managed VA range. All CUDA-managed pointers are within this VA range, and the range will always fall within the first 40 bits of the process’s VA space.\\\\nCUDA VA Space Addressing\\\\n\\\\nSubsequently, within the CUDA VA space, addresses can be subdivided into three types:\\\\nGPU\\\\nA page backed by GPU memory. This will not be accessible from the host and the VA in question will never have a physical backing on the host. Dereferencing a pointer to a GPU VA from the CPU will trigger a segfault.\\\\nCPU\\\\nA page backed by CPU memory. This will be accessible from both the host and the GPU at the same VA.\\\\nFREE\\\\nThese VAs are reserved by CUDA for future allocations.\\\\nThis partitioning allows the CUDA runtime to determine the physical location of a memory object by its pointer value within the reserved CUDA VA space.\\\\nAddresses are subdivided into these categories at page granularity; all memory within a page is of the same type. Note that GPU pages may not be the same size as CPU pages. The CPU pages are usually 4KB and the GPU pages on Kepler-class GPUs are 64KB. GPUDirect RDMA operates exclusively on GPU pages (created by\\\\ncudaMalloc()\\\\n) that are within this CUDA VA space.\\\\n4.2.\\\\nUserspace API\\\\n\\\\nData structures\\\\ntypedef\\\\nstruct\\\\nCUDA_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS_st\\\\n{\\\\nunsigned\\\\nlong\\\\nlong\\\\np2pToken\\\\n;\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nvaSpaceToken\\\\n;\\\\n}\\\\nCUDA_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\n;\\\\nFunction cuPointerSetAttribute()\\\\nCUresult\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\nvoid\\\\n*\\\\ndata\\\\n,\\\\nCUpointer_attribute\\\\nattribute\\\\n,\\\\nCUdeviceptr\\\\npointer\\\\n);\\\\nIn GPUDirect RDMA scope, the interesting usage is when\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_SYNC_MEMOPS\\\\nis passed as the\\\\nattribute\\\\n:\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nflag\\\\n=\\\\n1\\\\n;\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\nflag\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_SYNC_MEMOPS\\\\n,\\\\npointer\\\\n);\\\\nParameters\\\\ndata [in]\\\\nA pointer to a\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nvariable containing a boolean value.\\\\nattribute [in]\\\\nIn GPUDirect RDMA scope should always be\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_SYNC_MEMOPS\\\\n.\\\\npointer [in]\\\\nA pointer.\\\\nReturns\\\\nCUDA_SUCCESS\\\\nif pointer points to GPU memory and the CUDA driver was able to set the new behavior for the whole device memory allocation.\\\\nanything else\\\\nif pointer points to CPU memory.\\\\nIt is used to explicitly enable a strictly synchronizing behavior on the whole memory allocation pointed to by\\\\npointer\\\\n, and by doing so disabling all data transfer optimizations which might create problems with concurrent RDMA and CUDA memory copy operations. This API has CUDA synchronizing behavior, so it should be considered expensive and possibly invoked only once per buffer.\\\\nFunction cuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nCUresult\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\nconst\\\\nvoid\\\\n*\\\\ndata\\\\n,\\\\nCUpointer_attribute\\\\nattribute\\\\n,\\\\nCUdeviceptr\\\\npointer\\\\n);\\\\nThis function has two different attributes related to GPUDirect RDMA:\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\nand\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\n.\\\\nWarning\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS has been deprecated in CUDA 6.0\\\\nWhen\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\nis passed as the\\\\nattribute\\\\n,\\\\ndata\\\\nis a pointer to\\\\nCUDA_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\n:\\\\nCUDA_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\ntokens\\\\n;\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\ntokens\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\n,\\\\npointer\\\\n);\\\\nIn this case, the function returns two tokens for use with the\\\\nKernel API\\\\n.\\\\nParameters\\\\ndata [out]\\\\nStruct\\\\nCUDA_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\nwith the two tokens.\\\\nattribute [in]\\\\nIn GPUDirect RDMA scope should always be\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_P2P_TOKENS\\\\n.\\\\npointer [in]\\\\nA pointer.\\\\nReturns\\\\nCUDA_SUCCESS\\\\nif pointer points to GPU memory.\\\\nanything else\\\\nif pointer points to CPU memory.\\\\nThis function may be called at any time, including before CUDA initialization, and it has CUDA synchronizing behavior, as in\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_SYNC_MEMOPS\\\\n, so it should be considered expensive and should be invoked only once per buffer.\\\\nNote that values set in\\\\ntokens\\\\ncan be different for the same\\\\npointer\\\\nvalue during a lifetime of a user-space program. Refer to\\\\nTokens Usage\\\\nfor a concrete example.\\\\nNote that for security reasons the value set in\\\\np2pToken\\\\nwill be randomized, to prevent it from being guessed by an adversary.\\\\nIn CUDA 6.0, a new attribute has been introduced that is useful to detect memory reallocations.\\\\nWhen\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\nis passed as the\\\\nattribute\\\\n,\\\\ndata\\\\nis expected to point to a 64bit unsigned integer variable, like\\\\nuint64_t\\\\n.\\\\nuint64_t\\\\nbuf_id\\\\n;\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\n(\\\\n&\\\\nbuf_id\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\n,\\\\npointer\\\\n);\\\\nParameters\\\\ndata [out]\\\\nA pointer to a 64 bits variable where the buffer id will be stored.\\\\nattribute [in]\\\\nThe\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\nenumerator.\\\\npointer [in]\\\\nA pointer to GPU memory.\\\\nReturns\\\\nCUDA_SUCCESS\\\\nif pointer points to GPU memory.\\\\nanything else\\\\nif pointer points to CPU memory.\\\\nSome general remarks follow:\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nand\\\\ncuPointerSetAttribute()\\\\nare CUDA driver API functions only.\\\\nIn particular,\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nis not equivalent to\\\\ncudaPointerGetAttributes()\\\\n, as the required functionality is only present in the former function. This in no way limits the scope where GPUDirect RDMA may be used as\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nis compatible with the CUDA Runtime API.\\\\nNo runtime API equivalent to\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\nis provided. This is so as the additional overhead associated with the CUDA runtime API to driver API call sequence would introduce unneeded overhead and\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute()\\\\ncan be on the critical path, e.g. of communication libraries.\\\\nWhenever possible, we suggest to combine multiple calls to\\\\ncuPointerGetAttribute\\\\nby using\\\\ncuPointerGetAttributes\\\\n.\\\\nFunction ``cuPointerGetAttributes()``\\\\nCUresult\\\\ncuPointerGetAttributes\\\\n(\\\\nunsigned\\\\nint\\\\nnumAttributes\\\\n,\\\\nCUpointer_attribute\\\\n*\\\\nattributes\\\\n,\\\\nvoid\\\\n**\\\\ndata\\\\n,\\\\nCUdeviceptr\\\\nptr\\\\n);\\\\nThis function can be used to inspect multiple attributes at once. The one most probably related to GPUDirect RDMA are\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_BUFFER_ID\\\\n,\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_MEMORY_TYPE\\\\nand\\\\nCU_POINTER_ATTRIBUTE_IS_MANAGED\\\\n.\\\\n4.3.\\\\nKernel API\\\\n\\\\nThe following declarations can be found in the\\\\nnv-p2p.h\\\\nheader that is distributed in the NVIDIA Driver package. callback.\\\\n4.4.\\\\nPorting to Tegra\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA is supported on Jetson AGX Xavier platform from CUDA 10.1, on DRIVE AGX Xavier Linux based platforms from CUDA 11.2 and on Jetson Orin platform from CUDA 11.4. From this point onwards, this document will collectively refer Jetson and Drive as Tegra. Owing to hardware and software specific divergence of Tegra vis-a-vis Linux-Desktop, already developed applications needs to be slightly modified in order to port them to Tegra. The following sub-sections (4.4.1-4.4.3) briefs over the necessary changes.\\\\n4.4.1.\\\\nChanging the allocator\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect RDMA on Desktop allows applications to operate exclusively on GPU pages allocated using\\\\ncudaMalloc()\\\\n. On Tegra, applications will have to change the memory allocator from\\\\ncudaMalloc()\\\\nto\\\\ncudaHostAlloc()\\\\n. Applications can either:\\\\nTreat the returned pointer as if it is a device pointer, provided that the iGPU supports UVA or\\\\ncudaDevAttrCanUseHostPointerForRegisteredMem\\\\ndevice attribute is a non-zero value when queried using\\\\ncudaDeviceGetAttribute()\\\\nfor iGPU.\\\\nGet the device pointer corresponding to the host memory allocated using\\\\ncudaHostGetDevicePointer()\\\\n. Once the application has the device pointer, all the rules that are applicable to the standard GPUDirect solution also apply to Tegra.\\\\n4.4.2.\\\\nModification to Kernel API\\\\n\\\\nThe declarations under Tegra API column of the following table can be found in the nv-p2p.h header that is distributed in the NVIDIA Driver package. Refer to the inline documentation contained in that header file for a detailed description of the parameters and the return values. The table below represents the Kernel API changes on Tegra vis-a-vis Desktop.\\\\nDesktop API\\\\nTegra API\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_get_pages(uint64_t p2p_token, uint32_t va_space_token, uint64_t virtual_address, uint64_t length, struct nvidia_p2p_page_table **page_table, void ( *free_callback)(void *data), void *data);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_get_pages(u64 virtual_address, u64 length, struct nvidia_p2p_page_table **page_table, void (*free_callback)(void *data), void *data);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_put_pages(uint64_t p2p_token, uint32_t va_space_token, uint64_t virtual_address, struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_put_pages(struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_dma_map_pages(struct pci_dev *peer, struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table, struct nvidia_p2p_dma_mapping **dma_mapping);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_dma_map_pages(struct device *dev, struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table, struct nvidia_p2p_dma_mapping **dma_mapping, enum dma_data_direction direction);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_dma_unmap_pages(struct pci_dev *peer, struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table, struct nvidia_p2p_dma_mapping *dma_mapping);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_dma_unmap_pages(struct nvidia_p2p_dma_mapping *dma_mapping);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_free_page_table(struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_free_page_table(struct nvidia_p2p_page_table *page_table);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_free_dma_mapping(struct nvidia_p2p_dma_mapping *dma_mapping);\\\\nint nvidia_p2p_free_dma_mapping(struct nvidia_p2p_dma_mapping *dma_mapping);\\\\n4.4.3.\\\\nOther highlights\\\\n\\\\nThe length of the requested mapping and base address must be a multiple of 4KB, failing which leads to an error.\\\\nUnlike the Desktop version, callback registered at\\\\nnvidia_p2p_get_pages()\\\\nwill always be triggered when\\\\nnvidia_p2p_put_pages()\\\\nis invoked. It is the reponsibilty of the kernel driver to free the page_table allocated by calling\\\\nnvidia_p2p_free_page_table()\\\\n. Note that, similar to the Desktop version, the callback will also triggered in scenarios explained in\\\\nUnpin Callback\\\\n.\\\\nSince\\\\ncudaHostAlloc()\\\\ncan be allocated with\\\\ncudaHostAllocWriteCombined\\\\nflag or default flag, applications are expected to excercise caution when mapping the memory to userspace, for example using standard linux\\\\nmmap()\\\\n. In this regard:\\\\nWhen GPU memory is allocated as writecombined, the userspace mapping should also be done as writecombined by passing the\\\\nvm_page_prot\\\\nmember of\\\\nvm_area_struct\\\\nto the standard linux interface:\\\\n`pgprot_writecombine()\\\\n<\\\\nhttps://elixir.bootlin.com/linux/latest/source/arch/arm64/include/asm/pgtable.h#L403\\\\n>`__.\\\\nWhen GPU memory is allocated as default, no modifcations to the\\\\nvm_page_prot\\\\nmember of\\\\nvm_area_struct\\\\nshould be done.\\\\nIncompatible combination of map and allocation attributes will lead to undefined behavior.\\\\n5.\\\\nNotices\\\\n\\\\n5.1.\\\\nNotice\\\\n\\\\nThis document is provided for information purposes only and shall not be regarded as a warranty of a certain functionality, condition, or quality of a product. K-HW-012：存储 I/O：请求粒度、队列和加载流水\\\\n\\\\nSSD 的标称带宽只是某次访问模式下的能力；推理实际获得的是经过文件布局、页缓存、块层排队、设备传输、主存 staging、H2D 和消费者同步之后的供给速度。本章把一次加载拆成对象身份、文件范围、请求排队、完成匹配、布局转换、设备传送和缓冲释放，说明哪些字节必须到齐、哪个完成事件能解除何种责任，以及条件变化后哪些阶段会反转。\\\\n\\\\n## 问题、对象与完成边界\\\\n\\\\n设一个加载对象为 O=(a,t,R,g,z)。a 是固定制品版本；t 是张量或参数逻辑名及其源 shape、dtype、轴序和目标布局；R 是一组带文件身份的源范围；g 是本次加载尝试的代次；z 是目标物理槽的 lease 代次。一次文件请求可写成 X=(O,f,o,l,dest,g,z)，其中 f 绑定不可变文件内容版本，[o,o+l) 是该文件中的字节范围，dest 是本次尝试中的目的缓冲。路径字符串相同不证明文件内容版本相同；旧完成事件也不能因为地址相同而解除新 lease 的责任。\\\\n\\\\n合法性至少包括：源范围在固定 a 和 f 内且运算不溢出；目标范围容量、对齐和表示相容；同一槽没有被旧代次消费者继续读取；全部必需范围完成之后才发布对象；发生错误或短读时，只把已完成部分记为部分完成，不用旧缓冲填充缺失部分。缓存命中、mmap 成功、read 调用返回、H2D 入队、设备 kernel 完成和最后消费者释放是不同事件。\\\\n\\\\n| 状态 | 已经成立 | 尚不能推断 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| RESERVED | 目的槽和转换工作区已为本代预留 | 文件字节已到 |\\\\n| SUBMITTED | 请求已进入文件或块层路径 | 设备已服务或字节已完整 |\\\\n| PARTIAL | 某些范围已有成功字节 | 整个对象可发布 |\\\\n| HOST_READY | 必需源范围都到达主机缓冲且错误状态已知 | 布局转换和 H2D 已完成 |\\\\n| CONVERTED | 目标表示已形成 | 设备 DMA 已完成且消费者可见 |\\\\n| DEVICE_READY | H2D 完成且消费依赖已建立 | kernel 已读完并允许复用 |\\\\n| CONSUMED | 所有声明的消费者最后访问结束 | 写入已持久化 |\\\\n| FAILED | 失败范围和仍存活责任已知 | 其他无关对象必然失败 |\\\\n\\\\n## 文件布局、逻辑范围与可执行目标\\\\n\\\\n文件范围不是张量布局。权重可能按 shard、tensor 或目标设备分片保存，执行器却按层、专家或 tile 消费；一个逻辑读取范围可能跨多个文件或物理 extent，非连续表示还可能产生多个小读取和后续重排。设源 shape 为 s、轴排列为 p、目标 shape 为 u_k=s_{p_k}。行主序下源线性下标为 L_s(c)=Σ_i c_i∏_{j>i}s_j，目标线性下标为 L_u(q)=Σ_i q_i∏_{j>i}u_j；源段地址可写成 (a,f,o_t+e_sL_s(c))，目标地址为 base_t+e_dL_u(q)。这要求源数据、轴序、dtype 和目标基址都属于同一版本；坐标式正确也不能推出量化分组、字节序或 QKV 分段正确。\\\\n\\\\n把相邻请求合并成大块可以摊薄提交、元数据和队列开销，但会过读不需要的数据、增加暂存和首块等待。一个逻辑读取计划应区分有效字节、实际文件读取字节、块层物理请求字节、主机到设备字节和最终被消费者使用的字节。连续大权重可用固定块流水；随机专家块可能必须按实际路由读取，错误预取会占用带宽和容量但不改变模型函数；长 KV 范围还要与层计算和页缓存复用一起计算。\\\\n\\\\nServerlessLLM §4.1 报告的加载优化格式把每个 GPU 的目标张量分组到独立文件，索引记录 tensor.name、GPU id、offset 和 size，运行时用 base+offset 恢复张量视图，并把张量对齐到内存字；§4.2 用固定大小内存块池、直接文件访问、锁页内存和多阶段任务队列减少重复复制与碎片。这些是论文所述系统设计，不是所有文件格式、文件系统或设备的普遍保证。\\\\n\\\\n## 缓存、映射与直接 I/O 的合法性\\\\n\\\\n缓冲读取利用页缓存。页缓存命中可以减少存储事务，但应用仍然支付复制、检查和暂存；写入页缓存的返回也不等于脏页已经写回存储。mmap 让文件范围进入虚拟地址空间，但映射成功既不代表内容已驻留，也不代表首次访问不会缺页等待。多个进程可能共享只读文件页，而转换后的私有布局仍可能各持一份副本。\\\\n\\\\n直接 I/O 绕过页缓存，让应用管理块池、并发和复用，但有对齐、文件系统和具体路径约束。Linux 6.12 的 iomap 文档还指出：直接读和直接写可能在发起 I/O 前刷新相应页缓存，直接写前后可能使页缓存失效；请求可能短读、部分完成，某些路径可回退到缓冲 I/O，异步请求可能返回已排队状态，调用者要用已积累的进度继续。直接 I/O 不自动等于异步，不自动等于零复制，也不自动等于存储设备直接把数据送入 GPU。\\\\n\\\\n判断缓存还是直接 I/O，应固定字节和对象，分别观察冷缓存、热缓存、读取 CPU 时间、实际存储字节、主存峰值和后续消费者等待。热页缓存读速不能被记成 SSD 带宽；直接 I/O 也不保证比 mmap 快，因为它可能增加页缓存刷新、对齐检查、锁页或应用内部复制。\\\\n\\\\n## 请求粒度、队列深度与吞吐\\\\n\\\\n设每次请求大小为 b 字节，平均服务时间为 S(b)，则单服务路径的请求率为 1/S(b)，数据率为 b/S(b)。一个常用分解是 S(b)=S0+b/B_eff+W，其中 S0 包含提交、寻址和完成处理，B_eff 是当前访问模式下的可持续传输率，W 是排队等待。b 很小时可能先达到 IOPS 或 CPU 提交上限，b 很大时则可能受设备、链路、主存或 PCIe 上游带宽限制；超过对齐或消费者粒度的大块还会增加过读和尾块浪费。\\\\n\\\\n若目标数据率为 X，请求大小为 b，则请求到达率为 λ=X/b。由 Little 关系，平均在途请求数至少为 N≈λE[S(b)]；整数槽位取上界。设目标 4 GiB/s、平均完成时间 1 ms、请求大小 1 MiB，则 λ=4 GiB/s÷1 MiB=4096 次/s，4096×0.001=4.096，至少需要 5 个在途槽。4 个槽在此均值模型下只能提供 4×1 MiB÷0.001 s=3.90625 GiB/s，低于目标。这是带宽时延积的起点，不是实际设备曲线。\\\\n\\\\n队列稳定性还需要 ρ=λE[S]<1。对到达近似泊松、服务独立同分布的 M/G/1 FIFO 模型，W_q=λE[S^2]/(2(1−ρ))；它说明仅用平均服务时间不能解释尾延迟，服务时间方差和突发到达会抬高峰值。多个模型冷启动、权重预取和 KV 读取还共享同一 SSD、主存和 PCIe 上游，优先级应连接消费 deadline、可避免的重算收益和公平性；盲目增加深度可能只增加排队、取消排空和驻留。\\\\n\\\\n## 加载流水：算法、状态与缓冲复用\\\\n\\\\n把一块数据的路径写成 read→convert→H2D→consume。convert 可能在 CPU 上完成，也可能在设备上以 kernel 完成；若在设备上完成，就必须先完成 H2D，且不能在转换结束前把目标当作可执行权重。每个阶段都需要独立的资源、缓冲和完成关系。下面给出加载对象从预留到回收的抽象推进算法；它不指定具体文件、CUDA 或驱动 API。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 LoadBlocks(plan, events, pools)\\\\n输入：固定制品版本 a；按消费顺序排列的块 B_0...B_{N-1}，每块含源段、目标范围、代次、消费者集合和 deadline；各池容量与释放条件；完成事件队列\\\\n输出：每块状态、失败范围、仍需保护的槽和未完成责任\\\\n\\\\n初始化：对象状态为空；每个池槽记录 lease、拥有者和最后消费者；队列按 deadline 与公平约束组织\\\\n若 plan 为空：返回成功、无在途责任\\\\nfor i=0..N-1:\\\\n    校验源范围属于 a、目标表示相容，并等待 B_i 所需槽和工作区\\\\n    预留主机槽、设备槽和转换区，记录 lease_i 与本代范围\\\\n    提交 B_i 的读取请求；状态 SUBMITTED\\\\n    若提交失败：释放尚未发布的预留，标记 FAILED_i，保留错误原因\\\\nwhile 仍有在途读取、转换或 H2D:\\\\n    取下一完成事件 e，按对象、文件、范围、尝试代次和 lease 匹配\\\\n    若 e 属于旧代次或重复通知：只结算其资源，不推进当前对象\\\\n    若读取只完成部分范围：把已完成前缀记入 PARTIAL，未完成范围继续在途\\\\n    若读取失败：只把对应范围标为 FAILED，禁止发布整个对象\\\\n    若全部必需源范围 HOST_READY：\\\\n        执行布局转换；失败时保留部分输出和失败原因\\\\n        状态 CONVERTED，提交 H2D，并登记主机源缓冲的最后读取者\\\\n    若 H2D 完成且消费者依赖已建立：\\\\n        状态 DEVICE_READY，向 B_i 的消费者发布同一版本内容\\\\n        登记每个消费者的读取责任\\\\n    若所有消费者最后访问结束：\\\\n        状态 CONSUMED；归还设备槽、转换区和主机槽\\\\n    若发生取消：停止提交新工作，但保留已发起 I/O、DMA 和 kernel 的排空责任\\\\n若所有块 CONSUMED 且无在途责任：返回成功\\\\n否则：返回未完成对象、失败范围、隔离槽和仍需保护的资源\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n正确性不变量是：主机源缓冲在 H2D 实际读取结束前不得复用；设备输入在 kernel 最后读取结束前不得复用；转换输出在消费者取得正确版本前不得发布；旧代次完成事件不得释放新 lease；部分范围齐全前不能把未写区域混入新张量；零字节块可以立即满足载荷条件，但仍要建立版本、索引和消费者关系。取消只禁止后续业务推进，不会自动撤销已提交的物理操作。\\\\n\\\\n若各阶段使用独立资源、缓冲足够且没有额外跨块依赖，第 i 块第 k 阶段的完成时间可递推为 F[i,k]=max(F[i−1,k],F[i,k−1])+t[i,k]，边界为零。对 N 个大小相同、阶段时间相同的块，T_0=0，T_N=Σ_k t_k+(N−1)max_k t_k；它不是各阶段工作量的简单相加。若转换和 H2D 共用主存控制器或 PCIe 上游，或 CPU 读取与转换共用串行 worker，就必须加入资源边，递推中的独立资源假设不再成立。\\\\n\\\\n固定周期 P、固定生存期 L_j 的缓冲池至少需要 n_j≥⌈L_j/P⌉ 个槽；它只是所述周期下的必要条件。设 L=9、P=4，则需要 3 个槽：块 0 在 0 开始并到 9 才释放，块 2 在 8 开始时若只有 2 个槽就会复用块 0 的槽，形成覆盖。实际长度不一、完成乱序或取消排空时，必须按真实完成事件复用，平均值不能保证安全。多个池要分别计算主机读缓冲、转换输入输出、设备输入和设备输出，池的 reserved 与池内 active 槽也不能重复相加。\\\\n\\\\n## 硬件映射：文件范围到设备消费\\\\n\\\\n一次标准加载至少经过以下路径。第一，按固定清单和索引定位 (a,f,o,l)，校验范围与目标布局，申请主机块。第二，文件路径可能由页缓存满足，也可能发起直接 I/O；页缓存命中只是减少存储事务，用户缓冲仍需复制或映射。第三，进入块层后，请求可先进入软件暂存队列，相邻 sector 的请求可以合并，I/O scheduler 可以重排以改善公平或性能；随后进入硬件派发队列，受设备队列深度限制，不能立即派发的请求留在临时 dispatch 列表。设备完成时用 tag 通知对应的块层请求；块层和设备协议不保证完成顺序，应用必须按对象、范围和代次匹配。\\\\n\\\\n第四，主机必需范围全部到达后，执行必要的解包、转置、校验或设备端转换。若转换在 CPU 上，会产生源和目的两份暂存；若转换在 GPU 上，则先完成 H2D，再由 kernel 读取源并写目标，转换 kernel 完成前不能发布目标。第五，H2D 的完成只表示复制对相应执行依赖可见；源缓冲要保护到 DMA 实际读完，设备输入要保护到 kernel 最后读取。第六，消费者完成后再回收槽，不能以主机 API 返回或入队成功代替最后访问。\\\\n\\\\n绕过主机 staging、让外部 DMA 引擎直接访问 GPU 内存是这条路径上的另一条设计轴。NVIDIA GPUDirect RDMA 文档把网络接口、视频采集设备和存储适配器列为第三方设备示例；它要求设备共享同一上游 PCIe root complex，要求 IOMMU 为 1:1 或 pass-through 等平台条件，并通过注册、BAR 映射和页表把 GPU 内存暴露给外部设备。注册和 pin 可能很贵，文档提到可达毫秒级，因此常用 lazy unpinning 和 registration cache；撤销映射的回调要等待未完成 DMA，并可能阻塞数毫秒，必须避免死锁。\\\\n\\\\n更关键的是内存序：固定文档 §2.7 说明，只有 CPU 发起的 CUDA 同步或工作提交 API 能为 GPU 观察到 GPUDirect 操作提供顺序。外部 DMA 写入即使已经能被主机读回，若依赖它的 GPU kernel 在 DMA 对启动线程完成前已经开始，kernel 仍可能读到旧值、部分值或乱序值；此时并发 kernel 与 RDMA 写构成数据竞争。要让 kernel 看到新数据，必须让 DMA 写相对于发起依赖 kernel 的 CPU 线程完成。直通路径去掉一次主机中转和相应主存带宽占用，但不改变 SSD IOPS、请求粒度、排队、校验和格式转换；本库没有归档该路径的吞吐实测，不能把它写成无条件更快。\\\\n\\\\n写入还要区分应用缓冲可复用、数据已到存储栈、数据已满足持久性。缓冲写返回可能只落入页缓存；writeback 失败也可能在之后才通过同步接口报告。可重建的 KV 缓存与不可丢失的制品、提交记录应有不同的持久性合同；声称跨进程或机器故障恢复时，必须说明发布点、校验点、旧版本读者和持久化边界。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件化成本：从单块到整模型\\\\n\\\\n| 成本 | 应计算的对象与条件 | 常见漏算或重复计费 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 计算 | 索引、范围校验、合并、解包、转置、校验和、设备转换 kernel | 把存储带宽当成全部加载成本；漏掉转换和启动 |\\\\n| 访存 | 页缓存、主机 staging、目标张量、设备输入、转换读写 | 逻辑有效字节与实际过读、复制、读写方向混算 |\\\\n| 通信 | NVMe、PCIe、网络和共享上游；每请求固定开销与字节项 | 把热缓存读速记成 SSD 带宽；忽略多个模型共享链路 |\\\\n| 准备 | open、索引解析、池分配、锁页、注册、编解码器或 kernel 准备 | 把一次性准备摊成零；忽略取消失败后的排空 |\\\\n| 同步 | 队列等待、事件等待、fsync、回调、最后消费者完成 | 用 API 返回代替设备完成或持久化 |\\\\n| 驻留 | 在途槽、旧版本、页缓存、转换暂存、dispatch 列表 | 把 reserved 与 active 相加；把共享只读页重复计数 |\\\\n\\\\n设定 16 MiB 块，SSD 顺序读 4 GiB/s、主机到设备 16 GiB/s，纯传输时间分别为 16 MiB÷4 GiB/s=3.90625 ms 和 16 MiB÷16 GiB/s=0.9765625 ms。如果转换、CPU 调度和共享主存带宽另需时间，它们不能被这两项吸收。设四阶段时间分别为 8、3、2、5 ms，独立资源且缓冲足够时，四块完成时间为 18+(4−1)×8=42 ms；完全串行为 4×18=72 ms。42 ms 是设定整数时间的流水预测，不是目标机器实测；若转换与 H2D 争用同一 PCIe 或主存资源，42 ms 可能不可达。\\\\n\\\\n对更多块或更大模型，端到端时间应由依赖图、资源下界和有限排空共同决定。若资源 r 每块承担 Q_r 字节、在该并发条件下可持续带宽为 B_r，则启动周期还必须满足 P≥Q_r/B_r；例如 CPU 转换和 DMA 共用主存时，两者的读写流量要合并。多 rank 或多模型加载时，可把每个 rank 的排队 q_r 和本地流水 L_r 放入同一完成时间 T_ready=max_r(q_r+L_r)+T_barrier，但前提是 barrier 之后才需要共同发布；各 rank 的字节服务时间不能简单相加替代本地流水。\\\\n\\\\n容量账按唯一物理对象统计。主机读缓冲、设备槽、转换工作区和未释放旧版本各有生存期；同一 backing 的别名只计一次，共享只读页只计一次，确实复制的两份分别计。池的 reserved 已经包含其中 used 时不能再次相加；在途但尚未发布的对象必须占用容量。新旧模型并存、取消排空和失败重试都会出现在峰值中。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件变化后的保留、调整与放弃\\\\n\\\\n模型常驻且只冷启动一次时，复杂直接 I/O、注册缓存和深流水的准备成本可能难以摊销；频繁模型切换、多模型共享 SSD 或主存接近上限时，分块流水和可回收槽更重要。数据频繁复用且页缓存足够时，保留缓存路径可能更便宜；单遍大制品、缓存污染严重或需要应用精确控制驻留时，可比较直接 I/O 与有界块池。\\\\n\\\\nSSD 变快后，瓶颈可能移到 CPU 转换、页缓存刷新、锁页、PCIe 或设备消费；继续增加读取线程可能只增加主机驻留和队列。块太小增加提交、元数据、检查和尾块开销，块太大增加首块等待、过读和峰值；不存在脱离文件布局、设备并发、消费者粒度和尾延迟目标的通用最佳块大小。多模型环境下要让接近消费的 KV 或权重优先，不能让远期预取永久占满槽位。\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect 类直通路径在平台、IOMMU、驱动和第三方设备都满足条件时才合法；若存储 IOPS、格式转换或设备 kernel 是瓶颈，去掉主机中转未必改善端到端时间。若目标是不可丢失的提交记录，应先满足持久性合同，再讨论页缓存、直接 I/O 或写合并。若对象是可重建 KV，允许丢弃和重新计算是一种恢复选择，但重算会争用 CPU/GPU，不能把缓存丢失当成零成本。\\\\n\\\\n## 诊断：竞争解释与区分实验\\\\n\\\\n先固定对象版本、有效字节、冷热状态、并发和完成边界，再让竞争解释给出不同预测。一次总时间测量通常同时改变了 cache、队列、CPU 和驻留，不能单独定位原因。\\\\n\\\\n| 观察 | 竞争解释 | 区分实验 | 反证后的修正 |\\\\n|---|---|---|---|\\\\n| 加载吞吐低 | IOPS 上限、设备带宽、CPU 提交、转换、页缓存污染或共享链路 | 固定有效字节，比较冷/热缓存；扫描块大小；记录实际读取字节、队列等待、CPU 时间和各阶段完成 | 增大块只增加等待而不增加有效字节时，撤回纯带宽解释 |\\\\n| 队列更深但吞吐不升 | 设备已饱和、CPU/PCIe 受限、槽不足或请求粒度过小 | 固定工作量，改变在途槽数并记录完成率和排队；保持块大小和缓存状态 | 完成率不升而等待上升，说明深度只增加排队；先找共享资源 |\\\\n| 小块很多但大块不更快 | 提交开销、过读、尾块、转换或消费者粒度 | 在相同有效字节下比较多档块大小；分别记录首块、稳态和尾块时间 | 大块过读或尾延迟更差时，选择较小块或有界合并 |\\\\n| mmap 很快 | 页已驻留、文件在页缓存、只读共享或缺少冷访问 | 用冷缓存对照、独立进程和相同字节；记录缺页、实际存储字节和主存峰值 | 冷访问变慢时，不能把热映射速度当作存储能力 |\\\\n| 直接 I/O 变慢 | 对齐失败、回退、页缓存刷新、额外 staging 或队列不足 | 比较对齐/非对齐、干净/脏页缓存、单/多槽；记录短读和错误返回 | 出现刷新或回退时，路径成本不能只按设备带宽估 |\\\\n| 某些块发布后内容混杂 | 完成顺序被误当提交顺序、旧 completion 释放新 lease、部分范围被当成完整 | 打乱完成顺序；注入旧代次、重复完成和缺失范围；按对象和范围重取 | 旧事件只能结算旧责任；完整范围与错误状态齐备前不得发布 |\\\\n| 直通路径没有收益 | 平台不支持、注册成本、存储瓶颈、转换瓶颈或主机内存不是瓶颈 | 核实注册与映射条件；比较主机内存流量、单块延迟和关闭直通后的路径 | 的标称带宽只是某次访问模式下的能力；推理实际获得的是经过文件布局、页缓存、块层排队、设备传输、主存 staging、H2D 和消费者同步之后的供给速度。本章把一次加载拆成对象身份、文件范围、请求排队、完成匹配、布局转换、设备传送和缓冲释放，说明哪些字节必须到齐、哪个完成事件能解除何种责任，以及条件变化后哪些阶段会反转。\\\\n\\\\n## 问题、对象与完成边界\\\\n\\\\n设一个加载对象为 O=(a,t,R,g,z)。a 是固定制品版本；t 是张量或参数逻辑名及其源 shape、dtype、轴序和目标布局；R 是一组带文件身份的源范围；g 是本次加载尝试的代次；z 是目标物理槽的 lease 代次。一次文件请求可写成 X=(O,f,o,l,dest,g,z)，其中 f 绑定不可变文件内容版本，[o,o+l) 是该文件中的字节范围，dest 是本次尝试中的目的缓冲。路径字符串相同不证明文件内容版本相同；旧完成事件也不能因为地址相同而解除新 lease 的责任。\\\\n\\\\n合法性至少包括：源范围在固定 a 和 f 内且运算不溢出；目标范围容量、对齐和表示相容；同一槽没有被旧代次消费者继续读取；全部必需范围完成之后才发布对象；发生错误或短读时，只把已完成部分记为部分完成，不用旧缓冲填充缺失部分。缓存命中、mmap 成功、read 调用返回、H2D 入队、设备 kernel 完成和最后消费者释放是不同事件。\\\\n\\\\n| 状态 | 已经成立 | 尚不能推断 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| RESERVED | 目的槽和转换工作区已为本代预留 | 文件字节已到 |\\\\n| SUBMITTED | 请求已进入文件或块层路径 | 设备已服务或字节已完整 |\\\\n| PARTIAL | 某些范围已有成功字节 | 整个对象可发布 |\\\\n| HOST_READY | 必需源范围都到达主机缓冲且错误状态已知 | 布局转换和 H2D 已完成 |\\\\n| CONVERTED | 目标表示已形成 | 设备 DMA 已完成且消费者可见 |\\\\n| DEVICE_READY | H2D 完成且消费依赖已建立 | kernel 已读完并允许复用 |\\\\n| CONSUMED | 所有声明的消费者最后访问结束 | 写入已持久化 |\\\\n| FAILED | 失败范围和仍存活责任已知 | 其他无关对象必然失败 |\\\\n\\\\n## 文件布局、逻辑范围与可执行目标\\\\n\\\\n文件范围不是张量布局。权重可能按 shard、tensor 或目标设备分片保存，执行器却按层、专家或 tile 消费；一个逻辑读取范围可能跨多个文件或物理 extent，非连续表示还可能产生多个小读取和后续重排。设源 shape 为 s、轴排列为 p、目标 shape 为 u_k=s_{p_k}。行主序下源线性下标为 L_s(c)=Σ_i c_i∏_{j>i}s_j，目标线性下标为 L_u(q)=Σ_i q_i∏_{j>i}u_j；源段地址可写成 (a,f,o_t+e_sL_s(c))，目标地址为 base_t+e_dL_u(q)。这要求源数据、轴序、dtype 和目标基址都属于同一版本；坐标式正确也不能推出量化分组、字节序或 QKV 分段正确。\\\\n\\\\n把相邻请求合并成大块可以摊薄提交、元数据和队列开销，但会过读不需要的数据、增加暂存和首块等待。一个逻辑读取计划应区分有效字节、实际文件读取字节、块层物理请求字节、主机到设备字节和最终被消费者使用的字节。连续大权重可用固定块流水；随机专家块可能必须按实际路由读取，错误预取会占用带宽和容量但不改变模型函数；长 KV 范围还要与层计算和页缓存复用一起计算。\\\\n\\\\nServerlessLLM §4.1 报告的加载优化格式把每个 GPU 的目标张量分组到独立文件，索引记录 tensor.name、GPU id、offset 和 size，运行时用 base+offset 恢复张量视图，并把张量对齐到内存字；§4.2 用固定大小内存块池、直接文件访问、锁页内存和多阶段任务队列减少重复复制与碎片。这些是论文所述系统设计，不是所有文件格式、文件系统或设备的普遍保证。\\\\n\\\\n## 缓存、映射与直接 I/O 的合法性\\\\n\\\\n缓冲读取利用页缓存。页缓存命中可以减少存储事务，但应用仍然支付复制、检查和暂存；写入页缓存的返回也不等于脏页已经写回存储。mmap 让文件范围进入虚拟地址空间，但映射成功既不代表内容已驻留，也不代表首次访问不会缺页等待。多个进程可能共享只读文件页，而转换后的私有布局仍可能各持一份副本。\\\\n\\\\n直接 I/O 绕过页缓存，让应用管理块池、并发和复用，但有对齐、文件系统和具体路径约束。Linux 6.12 的 iomap 文档还指出：直接读和直接写可能在发起 I/O 前刷新相应页缓存，直接写前后可能使页缓存失效；请求可能短读、部分完成，某些路径可回退到缓冲 I/O，异步请求可能返回已排队状态，调用者要用已积累的进度继续。直接 I/O 不自动等于异步，不自动等于零复制，也不自动等于存储设备直接把数据送入 GPU。\\\\n\\\\n判断缓存还是直接 I/O，应固定字节和对象，分别观察冷缓存、热缓存、读取 CPU 时间、实际存储字节、主存峰值和后续消费者等待。热页缓存读速不能被记成 SSD 带宽；直接 I/O 也不保证比 mmap 快，因为它可能增加页缓存刷新、对齐检查、锁页或应用内部复制。\\\\n\\\\n## 请求粒度、队列深度与吞吐\\\\n\\\\n设每次请求大小为 b 字节，平均服务时间为 S(b)，则单服务路径的请求率为 1/S(b)，数据率为 b/S(b)。一个常用分解是 S(b)=S0+b/B_eff+W，其中 S0 包含提交、寻址和完成处理，B_eff 是当前访问模式下的可持续传输率，W 是排队等待。b 很小时可能先达到 IOPS 或 CPU 提交上限，b 很大时则可能受设备、链路、主存或 PCIe 上游带宽限制；超过对齐或消费者粒度的大块还会增加过读和尾块浪费。\\\\n\\\\n若目标数据率为 X，请求大小为 b，则请求到达率为 λ=X/b。由 Little 关系，平均在途请求数至少为 N≈λE[S(b)]；整数槽位取上界。设目标 4 GiB/s、平均完成时间 1 ms、请求大小 1 MiB，则 λ=4 GiB/s÷1 MiB=4096 次/s，4096×0.001=4.096，至少需要 5 个在途槽。4 个槽在此均值模型下只能提供 4×1 MiB÷0.001 s=3.90625 GiB/s，低于目标。这是带宽时延积的起点，不是实际设备曲线。\\\\n\\\\n队列稳定性还需要 ρ=λE[S]<1。对到达近似泊松、服务独立同分布的 M/G/1 FIFO 模型，W_q=λE[S^2]/(2(1−ρ))；它说明仅用平均服务时间不能解释尾延迟，服务时间方差和突发到达会抬高峰值。多个模型冷启动、权重预取和 KV 读取还共享同一 SSD、主存和 PCIe 上游，优先级应连接消费 deadline、可避免的重算收益和公平性；盲目增加深度可能只增加排队、取消排空和驻留。\\\\n\\\\n## 加载流水：算法、状态与缓冲复用\\\\n\\\\n把一块数据的路径写成 read→convert→H2D→consume。convert 可能在 CPU 上完成，也可能在设备上以 kernel 完成；若在设备上完成，就必须先完成 H2D，且不能在转换结束前把目标当作可执行权重。每个阶段都需要独立的资源、缓冲和完成关系。下面给出加载对象从预留到回收的抽象推进算法；它不指定具体文件、CUDA 或驱动 API。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 LoadBlocks(plan, events, pools)\\\\n输入：固定制品版本 a；按消费顺序排列的块 B_0...B_{N-1}，每块含源段、目标范围、代次、消费者集合和 deadline；各池容量与释放条件；完成事件队列\\\\n输出：每块状态、失败范围、仍需保护的槽和未完成责任\\\\n\\\\n初始化：对象状态为空；每个池槽记录 lease、拥有者和最后消费者；队列按 deadline 与公平约束组织\\\\n若 plan 为空：返回成功、无在途责任\\\\nfor i=0..N-1:\\\\n    校验源范围属于 a、目标表示相容，并等待 B_i 所需槽和工作区\\\\n    预留主机槽、设备槽和转换区，记录 lease_i 与本代范围\\\\n    提交 B_i 的读取请求；状态 SUBMITTED\\\\n    若提交失败：释放尚未发布的预留，标记 FAILED_i，保留错误原因\\\\nwhile 仍有在途读取、转换或 H2D:\\\\n    取下一完成事件 e，按对象、文件、范围、尝试代次和 lease 匹配\\\\n    若 e 属于旧代次或重复通知：只结算其资源，不推进当前对象\\\\n    若读取只完成部分范围：把已完成前缀记入 PARTIAL，未完成范围继续在途\\\\n    若读取失败：只把对应范围标为 FAILED，禁止发布整个对象\\\\n    若全部必需源范围 HOST_READY：\\\\n        执行布局转换；失败时保留部分输出和失败原因\\\\n        状态 CONVERTED，提交 H2D，并登记主机源缓冲的最后读取者\\\\n    若 H2D 完成且消费者依赖已建立：\\\\n        状态 DEVICE_READY，向 B_i 的消费者发布同一版本内容\\\\n        登记每个消费者的读取责任\\\\n    若所有消费者最后访问结束：\\\\n        状态 CONSUMED；归还设备槽、转换区和主机槽\\\\n    若发生取消：停止提交新工作，但保留已发起 I/O、DMA 和 kernel 的排空责任\\\\n若所有块 CONSUMED 且无在途责任：返回成功\\\\n否则：返回未完成对象、失败范围、隔离槽和仍需保护的资源\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n正确性不变量是：主机源缓冲在 H2D 实际读取结束前不得复用；设备输入在 kernel 最后读取结束前不得复用；转换输出在消费者取得正确版本前不得发布；旧代次完成事件不得释放新 lease；部分范围齐全前不能把未写区域混入新张量；零字节块可以立即满足载荷条件，但仍要建立版本、索引和消费者关系。取消只禁止后续业务推进，不会自动撤销已提交的物理操作。\\\\n\\\\n若各阶段使用独立资源、缓冲足够且没有额外跨块依赖，第 i 块第 k 阶段的完成时间可递推为 F[i,k]=max(F[i−1,k],F[i,k−1])+t[i,k]，边界为零。对 N 个大小相同、阶段时间相同的块，T_0=0，T_N=Σ_k t_k+(N−1)max_k t_k；它不是各阶段工作量的简单相加。若转换和 H2D 共用主存控制器或 PCIe 上游，或 CPU 读取与转换共用串行 worker，就必须加入资源边，递推中的独立资源假设不再成立。\\\\n\\\\n固定周期 P、固定生存期 L_j 的缓冲池至少需要 n_j≥⌈L_j/P⌉ 个槽；它只是所述周期下的必要条件。设 L=9、P=4，则需要 3 个槽：块 0 在 0 开始并到 9 才释放，块 2 在 8 开始时若只有 2 个槽就会复用块 0 的槽，形成覆盖。实际长度不一、完成乱序或取消排空时，必须按真实完成事件复用，平均值不能保证安全。多个池要分别计算主机读缓冲、转换输入输出、设备输入和设备输出，池的 reserved 与池内 active 槽也不能重复相加。\\\\n\\\\n## 硬件映射：文件范围到设备消费\\\\n\\\\n一次标准加载至少经过以下路径。第一，按固定清单和索引定位 (a,f,o,l)，校验范围与目标布局，申请主机块。第二，文件路径可能由页缓存满足，也可能发起直接 I/O；页缓存命中只是减少存储事务，用户缓冲仍需复制或映射。第三，进入块层后，请求可先进入软件暂存队列，相邻 sector 的请求可以合并，I/O scheduler 可以重排以改善公平或性能；随后进入硬件派发队列，受设备队列深度限制，不能立即派发的请求留在临时 dispatch 列表。设备完成时用 tag 通知对应的块层请求；块层和设备协议不保证完成顺序，应用必须按对象、范围和代次匹配。\\\\n\\\\n第四，主机必需范围全部到达后，执行必要的解包、转置、校验或设备端转换。若转换在 CPU 上，会产生源和目的两份暂存；若转换在 GPU 上，则先完成 H2D，再由 kernel 读取源并写目标，转换 kernel 完成前不能发布目标。第五，H2D 的完成只表示复制对相应执行依赖可见；源缓冲要保护到 DMA 实际读完，设备输入要保护到 kernel 最后读取。第六，消费者完成后再回收槽，不能以主机 API 返回或入队成功代替最后访问。\\\\n\\\\n绕过主机 staging、让外部 DMA 引擎直接访问 GPU 内存是这条路径上的另一条设计轴。NVIDIA GPUDirect RDMA 文档把网络接口、视频采集设备和存储适配器列为第三方设备示例；它要求设备共享同一上游 PCIe root complex，要求 IOMMU 为 1:1 或 pass-through 等平台条件，并通过注册、BAR 映射和页表把 GPU 内存暴露给外部设备。注册和 pin 可能很贵，文档提到可达毫秒级，因此常用 lazy unpinning 和 registration cache；撤销映射的回调要等待未完成 DMA，并可能阻塞数毫秒，必须避免死锁。\\\\n\\\\n更关键的是内存序：固定文档 §2.7 说明，只有 CPU 发起的 CUDA 同步或工作提交 API 能为 GPU 观察到 GPUDirect 操作提供顺序。外部 DMA 写入即使已经能被主机读回，若依赖它的 GPU kernel 在 DMA 对启动线程完成前已经开始，kernel 仍可能读到旧值、部分值或乱序值；此时并发 kernel 与 RDMA 写构成数据竞争。要让 kernel 看到新数据，必须让 DMA 写相对于发起依赖 kernel 的 CPU 线程完成。直通路径去掉一次主机中转和相应主存带宽占用，但不改变 SSD IOPS、请求粒度、排队、校验和格式转换；本库没有归档该路径的吞吐实测，不能把它写成无条件更快。\\\\n\\\\n写入还要区分应用缓冲可复用、数据已到存储栈、数据已满足持久性。缓冲写返回可能只落入页缓存；writeback 失败也可能在之后才通过同步接口报告。可重建的 KV 缓存与不可丢失的制品、提交记录应有不同的持久性合同；声称跨进程或机器故障恢复时，必须说明发布点、校验点、旧版本读者和持久化边界。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件化成本：从单块到整模型\\\\n\\\\n| 成本 | 应计算的对象与条件 | 常见漏算或重复计费 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 计算 | 索引、范围校验、合并、解包、转置、校验和、设备转换 kernel | 把存储带宽当成全部加载成本；漏掉转换和启动 |\\\\n| 访存 | 页缓存、主机 staging、目标张量、设备输入、转换读写 | 逻辑有效字节与实际过读、复制、读写方向混算 |\\\\n| 通信 | NVMe、PCIe、网络和共享上游；每请求固定开销与字节项 | 把热缓存读速记成 SSD 带宽；忽略多个模型共享链路 |\\\\n| 准备 | open、索引解析、池分配、锁页、注册、编解码器或 kernel 准备 | 把一次性准备摊成零；忽略取消失败后的排空 |\\\\n| 同步 | 队列等待、事件等待、fsync、回调、最后消费者完成 | 用 API 返回代替设备完成或持久化 |\\\\n| 驻留 | 在途槽、旧版本、页缓存、转换暂存、dispatch 列表 | 把 reserved 与 active 相加；把共享只读页重复计数 |\\\\n\\\\n设定 16 MiB 块，SSD 顺序读 4 GiB/s、主机到设备 16 GiB/s，纯传输时间分别为 16 MiB÷4 GiB/s=3.90625 ms 和 16 MiB÷16 GiB/s=0.9765625 ms。如果转换、CPU 调度和共享主存带宽另需时间，它们不能被这两项吸收。设四阶段时间分别为 8、3、2、5 ms，独立资源且缓冲足够时，四块完成时间为 18+(4−1)×8=42 ms；完全串行为 4×18=72 ms。42 ms 是设定整数时间的流水预测，不是目标机器实测；若转换与 H2D 争用同一 PCIe 或主存资源，42 ms 可能不可达。\\\\n\\\\n对更多块或更大模型，端到端时间应由依赖图、资源下界和有限排空共同决定。若资源 r 每块承担 Q_r 字节、在该并发条件下可持续带宽为 B_r，则启动周期还必须满足 P≥Q_r/B_r；例如 CPU 转换和 DMA 共用主存时，两者的读写流量要合并。多 rank 或多模型加载时，可把每个 rank 的排队 q_r 和本地流水 L_r 放入同一完成时间 T_ready=max_r(q_r+L_r)+T_barrier，但前提是 barrier 之后才需要共同发布；各 rank 的字节服务时间不能简单相加替代本地流水。\\\\n\\\\n容量账按唯一物理对象统计。主机读缓冲、设备槽、转换工作区和未释放旧版本各有生存期；同一 backing 的别名只计一次，共享只读页只计一次，确实复制的两份分别计。池的 reserved 已经包含其中 used 时不能再次相加；在途但尚未发布的对象必须占用容量。新旧模型并存、取消排空和失败重试都会出现在峰值中。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件变化后的保留、调整与放弃\\\\n\\\\n模型常驻且只冷启动一次时，复杂直接 I/O、注册缓存和深流水的准备成本可能难以摊销；频繁模型切换、多模型共享 SSD 或主存接近上限时，分块流水和可回收槽更重要。数据频繁复用且页缓存足够时，保留缓存路径可能更便宜；单遍大制品、缓存污染严重或需要应用精确控制驻留时，可比较直接 I/O 与有界块池。\\\\n\\\\nSSD 变快后，瓶颈可能移到 CPU 转换、页缓存刷新、锁页、PCIe 或设备消费；继续增加读取线程可能只增加主机驻留和队列。块太小增加提交、元数据、检查和尾块开销，块太大增加首块等待、过读和峰值；不存在脱离文件布局、设备并发、消费者粒度和尾延迟目标的通用最佳块大小。多模型环境下要让接近消费的 KV 或权重优先，不能让远期预取永久占满槽位。\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect 类直通路径在平台、IOMMU、驱动和第三方设备都满足条件时才合法；若存储 IOPS、格式转换或设备 kernel 是瓶颈，去掉主机中转未必改善端到端时间。若目标是不可丢失的提交记录，应先满足持久性合同，再讨论页缓存、直接 I/O 或写合并。若对象是可重建 KV，允许丢弃和重新计算是一种恢复选择，但重算会争用 CPU/GPU，不能把缓存丢失当成零成本。\\\\n\\\\n## 诊断：竞争解释与区分实验\\\\n\\\\n先固定对象版本、有效字节、冷热状态、并发和完成边界，再让竞争解释给出不同预测。一次总时间测量通常同时改变了 cache、队列、CPU 和驻留，不能单独定位原因。\\\\n\\\\n| 观察 | 竞争解释 | 区分实验 | 反证后的修正 |\\\\n|---|---|---|---|\\\\n| 加载吞吐低 | IOPS 上限、设备带宽、CPU 提交、转换、页缓存污染或共享链路 | 固定有效字节，比较冷/热缓存；扫描块大小；记录实际读取字节、队列等待、CPU 时间和各阶段完成 | 增大块只增加等待而不增加有效字节时，撤回纯带宽解释 |\\\\n| 队列更深但吞吐不升 | 设备已饱和、CPU/PCIe 受限、槽不足或请求粒度过小 | 固定工作量，改变在途槽数并记录完成率和排队；保持块大小和缓存状态 | 完成率不升而等待上升，说明深度只增加排队；先找共享资源 |\\\\n| 小块很多但大块不更快 | 提交开销、过读、尾块、转换或消费者粒度 | 在相同有效字节下比较多档块大小；分别记录首块、稳态和尾块时间 | 大块过读或尾延迟更差时，选择较小块或有界合并 |\\\\n| mmap 很快 | 页已驻留、文件在页缓存、只读共享或缺少冷访问 | 用冷缓存对照、独立进程和相同字节；记录缺页、实际存储字节和主存峰值 | 冷访问变慢时，不能把热映射速度当作存储能力 |\\\\n| 直接 I/O 变慢 | 对齐失败、回退、页缓存刷新、额外 staging 或队列不足 | 比较对齐/非对齐、干净/脏页缓存、单/多槽；记录短读和错误返回 | 出现刷新或回退时，路径成本不能只按设备带宽估 |\\\\n| 某些块发布后内容混杂 | 完成顺序被误当提交顺序、旧 completion 释放新 lease、部分范围被当成完整 | 打乱完成顺序；注入旧代次、重复完成和缺失范围；按对象和范围重取 | 旧事件只能结算旧责任；完整范围与错误状态齐备前不得发布 |\\\\n| 直通路径没有收益 | 平台不支持、注册成本、存储瓶颈、转换瓶颈或主机内存不是瓶颈 | 核实注册与映射条件；比较主机内存流量、单块延迟和关闭直通后的路径 | 存储或转换仍占主导时，不能把直通当作通用加速 |\\\\n| 写入返回但恢复后缺失 | 页缓存未写回、文件系统或设备缓存、提交点不清、旧版本被提前删除 | 在明确故障点检查同步、清单发布和旧读者；区分缓存丢失与持久状态丢失 | 只有持久性合同满足后才报告可恢复；可重算缓存另行处理 |\\\\n\\\\n负对照应触发实质错误：把串行工作量当作流水完成时间、给 9 ms 生存期和 4 ms 周期只配 2 个槽、忽略代次只按偏移拼接范围、或在 DMA 完成前启动依赖 kernel，都应被检查拒绝。若系统只在全设备同步后恢复正常，不能由此唯一定位缺的是哪条依赖边，因为同步同时改变了多个候选关系。\\\\n\\\\n## 检查与证据范围\\\\n\\\\n配套 `tools/check_k_hw_012_full.py` 是 Python 标准库 CPU 整数/事件模型，不执行文件 I/O、块设备、CUDA、PCIe 或 GPUDirect。它用独立递推和闭式公式核对有限块流水，覆盖 N=0、零持续时间和不同块数；用槽区间重叠核对固定周期下的最少槽数，并实际构造少一个槽的覆盖错误；用范围并集核对部分完成、乱序完成、重复范围、空载荷和旧代次隔离；用 GPUDirect 的“DMA 对 CPU 线程完成后才允许依赖 kernel”核对提前启动与提前 的标称带宽只是某次访问模式下的能力；推理实际获得的是经过文件布局、页缓存、块层排队、设备传输、主存 staging、H2D 和消费者同步之后的供给速度。本章把一次加载拆成对象身份、文件范围、请求排队、完成匹配、布局转换、设备传送和缓冲释放，说明哪些字节必须到齐、哪个完成事件能解除何种责任，以及条件变化后哪些阶段会反转。\\\\n\\\\n## 问题、对象与完成边界\\\\n\\\\n设一个加载对象为 O=(a,t,R,g,z)。a 是固定制品版本；t 是张量或参数逻辑名及其源 shape、dtype、轴序和目标布局；R 是一组带文件身份的源范围；g 是本次加载尝试的代次；z 是目标物理槽的 lease 代次。一次文件请求可写成 X=(O,f,o,l,dest,g,z)，其中 f 绑定不可变文件内容版本，[o,o+l) 是该文件中的字节范围，dest 是本次尝试中的目的缓冲。路径字符串相同不证明文件内容版本相同；旧完成事件也不能因为地址相同而解除新 lease 的责任。\\\\n\\\\n合法性至少包括：源范围在固定 a 和 f 内且运算不溢出；目标范围容量、对齐和表示相容；同一槽没有被旧代次消费者继续读取；全部必需范围完成之后才发布对象；发生错误或短读时，只把已完成部分记为部分完成，不用旧缓冲填充缺失部分。缓存命中、mmap 成功、read 调用返回、H2D 入队、设备 kernel 完成和最后消费者释放是不同事件。\\\\n\\\\n| 状态 | 已经成立 | 尚不能推断 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| RESERVED | 目的槽和转换工作区已为本代预留 | 文件字节已到 |\\\\n| SUBMITTED | 请求已进入文件或块层路径 | 设备已服务或字节已完整 |\\\\n| PARTIAL | 某些范围已有成功字节 | 整个对象可发布 |\\\\n| HOST_READY | 必需源范围都到达主机缓冲且错误状态已知 | 布局转换和 H2D 已完成 |\\\\n| CONVERTED | 目标表示已形成 | 设备 DMA 已完成且消费者可见 |\\\\n| DEVICE_READY | H2D 完成且消费依赖已建立 | kernel 已读完并允许复用 |\\\\n| CONSUMED | 所有声明的消费者最后访问结束 | 写入已持久化 |\\\\n| FAILED | 失败范围和仍存活责任已知 | 其他无关对象必然失败 |\\\\n\\\\n## 文件布局、逻辑范围与可执行目标\\\\n\\\\n文件范围不是张量布局。权重可能按 shard、tensor 或目标设备分片保存，执行器却按层、专家或 tile 消费；一个逻辑读取范围可能跨多个文件或物理 extent，非连续表示还可能产生多个小读取和后续重排。设源 shape 为 s、轴排列为 p、目标 shape 为 u_k=s_{p_k}。行主序下源线性下标为 L_s(c)=Σ_i c_i∏_{j>i}s_j，目标线性下标为 L_u(q)=Σ_i q_i∏_{j>i}u_j；源段地址可写成 (a,f,o_t+e_sL_s(c))，目标地址为 base_t+e_dL_u(q)。这要求源数据、轴序、dtype 和目标基址都属于同一版本；坐标式正确也不能推出量化分组、字节序或 QKV 分段正确。\\\\n\\\\n把相邻请求合并成大块可以摊薄提交、元数据和队列开销，但会过读不需要的数据、增加暂存和首块等待。一个逻辑读取计划应区分有效字节、实际文件读取字节、块层物理请求字节、主机到设备字节和最终被消费者使用的字节。连续大权重可用固定块流水；随机专家块可能必须按实际路由读取，错误预取会占用带宽和容量但不改变模型函数；长 KV 范围还要与层计算和页缓存复用一起计算。\\\\n\\\\nServerlessLLM §4.1 报告的加载优化格式把每个 GPU 的目标张量分组到独立文件，索引记录 tensor.name、GPU id、offset 和 size，运行时用 base+offset 恢复张量视图，并把张量对齐到内存字；§4.2 用固定大小内存块池、直接文件访问、锁页内存和多阶段任务队列减少重复复制与碎片。这些是论文所述系统设计，不是所有文件格式、文件系统或设备的普遍保证。\\\\n\\\\n## 缓存、映射与直接 I/O 的合法性\\\\n\\\\n缓冲读取利用页缓存。页缓存命中可以减少存储事务，但应用仍然支付复制、检查和暂存；写入页缓存的返回也不等于脏页已经写回存储。mmap 让文件范围进入虚拟地址空间，但映射成功既不代表内容已驻留，也不代表首次访问不会缺页等待。多个进程可能共享只读文件页，而转换后的私有布局仍可能各持一份副本。\\\\n\\\\n直接 I/O 绕过页缓存，让应用管理块池、并发和复用，但有对齐、文件系统和具体路径约束。Linux 6.12 的 iomap 文档还指出：直接读和直接写可能在发起 I/O 前刷新相应页缓存，直接写前后可能使页缓存失效；请求可能短读、部分完成，某些路径可回退到缓冲 I/O，异步请求可能返回已排队状态，调用者要用已积累的进度继续。直接 I/O 不自动等于异步，不自动等于零复制，也不自动等于存储设备直接把数据送入 GPU。\\\\n\\\\n判断缓存还是直接 I/O，应固定字节和对象，分别观察冷缓存、热缓存、读取 CPU 时间、实际存储字节、主存峰值和后续消费者等待。热页缓存读速不能被记成 SSD 带宽；直接 I/O 也不保证比 mmap 快，因为它可能增加页缓存刷新、对齐检查、锁页或应用内部复制。\\\\n\\\\n## 请求粒度、队列深度与吞吐\\\\n\\\\n设每次请求大小为 b 字节，平均服务时间为 S(b)，则单服务路径的请求率为 1/S(b)，数据率为 b/S(b)。一个常用分解是 S(b)=S0+b/B_eff+W，其中 S0 包含提交、寻址和完成处理，B_eff 是当前访问模式下的可持续传输率，W 是排队等待。b 很小时可能先达到 IOPS 或 CPU 提交上限，b 很大时则可能受设备、链路、主存或 PCIe 上游带宽限制；超过对齐或消费者粒度的大块还会增加过读和尾块浪费。\\\\n\\\\n若目标数据率为 X，请求大小为 b，则请求到达率为 λ=X/b。由 Little 关系，平均在途请求数至少为 N≈λE[S(b)]；整数槽位取上界。设目标 4 GiB/s、平均完成时间 1 ms、请求大小 1 MiB，则 λ=4 GiB/s÷1 MiB=4096 次/s，4096×0.001=4.096，至少需要 5 个在途槽。4 个槽在此均值模型下只能提供 4×1 MiB÷0.001 s=3.90625 GiB/s，低于目标。这是带宽时延积的起点，不是实际设备曲线。\\\\n\\\\n队列稳定性还需要 ρ=λE[S]<1。对到达近似泊松、服务独立同分布的 M/G/1 FIFO 模型，W_q=λE[S^2]/(2(1−ρ))；它说明仅用平均服务时间不能解释尾延迟，服务时间方差和突发到达会抬高峰值。多个模型冷启动、权重预取和 KV 读取还共享同一 SSD、主存和 PCIe 上游，优先级应连接消费 deadline、可避免的重算收益和公平性；盲目增加深度可能只增加排队、取消排空和驻留。\\\\n\\\\n## 加载流水：算法、状态与缓冲复用\\\\n\\\\n把一块数据的路径写成 read→convert→H2D→consume。convert 可能在 CPU 上完成，也可能在设备上以 kernel 完成；若在设备上完成，就必须先完成 H2D，且不能在转换结束前把目标当作可执行权重。每个阶段都需要独立的资源、缓冲和完成关系。下面给出加载对象从预留到回收的抽象推进算法；它不指定具体文件、CUDA 或驱动 API。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 LoadBlocks(plan, events, pools)\\\\n输入：固定制品版本 a；按消费顺序排列的块 B_0...B_{N-1}，每块含源段、目标范围、代次、消费者集合和 deadline；各池容量与释放条件；完成事件队列\\\\n输出：每块状态、失败范围、仍需保护的槽和未完成责任\\\\n\\\\n初始化：对象状态为空；每个池槽记录 lease、拥有者和最后消费者；队列按 deadline 与公平约束组织\\\\n若 plan 为空：返回成功、无在途责任\\\\nfor i=0..N-1:\\\\n    校验源范围属于 a、目标表示相容，并等待 B_i 所需槽和工作区\\\\n    预留主机槽、设备槽和转换区，记录 lease_i 与本代范围\\\\n    提交 B_i 的读取请求；状态 SUBMITTED\\\\n    若提交失败：释放尚未发布的预留，标记 FAILED_i，保留错误原因\\\\nwhile 仍有在途读取、转换或 H2D:\\\\n    取下一完成事件 e，按对象、文件、范围、尝试代次和 lease 匹配\\\\n    若 e 属于旧代次或重复通知：只结算其资源，不推进当前对象\\\\n    若读取只完成部分范围：把已完成前缀记入 PARTIAL，未完成范围继续在途\\\\n    若读取失败：只把对应范围标为 FAILED，禁止发布整个对象\\\\n    若全部必需源范围 HOST_READY：\\\\n        执行布局转换；失败时保留部分输出和失败原因\\\\n        状态 CONVERTED，提交 H2D，并登记主机源缓冲的最后读取者\\\\n    若 H2D 完成且消费者依赖已建立：\\\\n        状态 DEVICE_READY，向 B_i 的消费者发布同一版本内容\\\\n        登记每个消费者的读取责任\\\\n    若所有消费者最后访问结束：\\\\n        状态 CONSUMED；归还设备槽、转换区和主机槽\\\\n    若发生取消：停止提交新工作，但保留已发起 I/O、DMA 和 kernel 的排空责任\\\\n若所有块 CONSUMED 且无在途责任：返回成功\\\\n否则：返回未完成对象、失败范围、隔离槽和仍需保护的资源\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n正确性不变量是：主机源缓冲在 H2D 实际读取结束前不得复用；设备输入在 kernel 最后读取结束前不得复用；转换输出在消费者取得正确版本前不得发布；旧代次完成事件不得释放新 lease；部分范围齐全前不能把未写区域混入新张量；零字节块可以立即满足载荷条件，但仍要建立版本、索引和消费者关系。取消只禁止后续业务推进，不会自动撤销已提交的物理操作。\\\\n\\\\n若各阶段使用独立资源、缓冲足够且没有额外跨块依赖，第 i 块第 k 阶段的完成时间可递推为 F[i,k]=max(F[i−1,k],F[i,k−1])+t[i,k]，边界为零。对 N 个大小相同、阶段时间相同的块，T_0=0，T_N=Σ_k t_k+(N−1)max_k t_k；它不是各阶段工作量的简单相加。若转换和 H2D 共用主存控制器或 PCIe 上游，或 CPU 读取与转换共用串行 worker，就必须加入资源边，递推中的独立资源假设不再成立。\\\\n\\\\n固定周期 P、固定生存期 L_j 的缓冲池至少需要 n_j≥⌈L_j/P⌉ 个槽；它只是所述周期下的必要条件。设 L=9、P=4，则需要 3 个槽：块 0 在 0 开始并到 9 才释放，块 2 在 8 开始时若只有 2 个槽就会复用块 0 的槽，形成覆盖。实际长度不一、完成乱序或取消排空时，必须按真实完成事件复用，平均值不能保证安全。多个池要分别计算主机读缓冲、转换输入输出、设备输入和设备输出，池的 reserved 与池内 active 槽也不能重复相加。\\\\n\\\\n## 硬件映射：文件范围到设备消费\\\\n\\\\n一次标准加载至少经过以下路径。第一，按固定清单和索引定位 (a,f,o,l)，校验范围与目标布局，申请主机块。第二，文件路径可能由页缓存满足，也可能发起直接 I/O；页缓存命中只是减少存储事务，用户缓冲仍需复制或映射。第三，进入块层后，请求可先进入软件暂存队列，相邻 sector 的请求可以合并，I/O scheduler 可以重排以改善公平或性能；随后进入硬件派发队列，受设备队列深度限制，不能立即派发的请求留在临时 dispatch 列表。设备完成时用 tag 通知对应的块层请求；块层和设备协议不保证完成顺序，应用必须按对象、范围和代次匹配。\\\\n\\\\n第四，主机必需范围全部到达后，执行必要的解包、转置、校验或设备端转换。若转换在 CPU 上，会产生源和目的两份暂存；若转换在 GPU 上，则先完成 H2D，再由 kernel 读取源并写目标，转换 kernel 完成前不能发布目标。第五，H2D 的完成只表示复制对相应执行依赖可见；源缓冲要保护到 DMA 实际读完，设备输入要保护到 kernel 最后读取。第六，消费者完成后再回收槽，不能以主机 API 返回或入队成功代替最后访问。\\\\n\\\\n绕过主机 staging、让外部 DMA 引擎直接访问 GPU 内存是这条路径上的另一条设计轴。NVIDIA GPUDirect RDMA 文档把网络接口、视频采集设备和存储适配器列为第三方设备示例；它要求设备共享同一上游 PCIe root complex，要求 IOMMU 为 1:1 或 pass-through 等平台条件，并通过注册、BAR 映射和页表把 GPU 内存暴露给外部设备。注册和 pin 可能很贵，文档提到可达毫秒级，因此常用 lazy unpinning 和 registration cache；撤销映射的回调要等待未完成 DMA，并可能阻塞数毫秒，必须避免死锁。\\\\n\\\\n更关键的是内存序：固定文档 §2.7 说明，只有 CPU 发起的 CUDA 同步或工作提交 API 能为 GPU 观察到 GPUDirect 操作提供顺序。外部 DMA 写入即使已经能被主机读回，若依赖它的 GPU kernel 在 DMA 对启动线程完成前已经开始，kernel 仍可能读到旧值、部分值或乱序值；此时并发 kernel 与 RDMA 写构成数据竞争。要让 kernel 看到新数据，必须让 DMA 写相对于发起依赖 kernel 的 CPU 线程完成。直通路径去掉一次主机中转和相应主存带宽占用，但不改变 SSD IOPS、请求粒度、排队、校验和格式转换；本库没有归档该路径的吞吐实测，不能把它写成无条件更快。\\\\n\\\\n写入还要区分应用缓冲可复用、数据已到存储栈、数据已满足持久性。缓冲写返回可能只落入页缓存；writeback 失败也可能在之后才通过同步接口报告。可重建的 KV 缓存与不可丢失的制品、提交记录应有不同的持久性合同；声称跨进程或机器故障恢复时，必须说明发布点、校验点、旧版本读者和持久化边界。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件化成本：从单块到整模型\\\\n\\\\n| 成本 | 应计算的对象与条件 | 常见漏算或重复计费 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 计算 | 索引、范围校验、合并、解包、转置、校验和、设备转换 kernel | 把存储带宽当成全部加载成本；漏掉转换和启动 |\\\\n| 访存 | 页缓存、主机 staging、目标张量、设备输入、转换读写 | 逻辑有效字节与实际过读、复制、读写方向混算 |\\\\n| 通信 | NVMe、PCIe、网络和共享上游；每请求固定开销与字节项 | 把热缓存读速记成 SSD 带宽；忽略多个模型共享链路 |\\\\n| 准备 | open、索引解析、池分配、锁页、注册、编解码器或 kernel 准备 | 把一次性准备摊成零；忽略取消失败后的排空 |\\\\n| 同步 | 队列等待、事件等待、fsync、回调、最后消费者完成 | 用 API 返回代替设备完成或持久化 |\\\\n| 驻留 | 在途槽、旧版本、页缓存、转换暂存、dispatch 列表 | 把 reserved 与 active 相加；把共享只读页重复计数 |\\\\n\\\\n设定 16 MiB 块，SSD 顺序读 4 GiB/s、主机到设备 16 GiB/s，纯传输时间分别为 16 MiB÷4 GiB/s=3.90625 ms 和 16 MiB÷16 GiB/s=0.9765625 ms。如果转换、CPU 调度和共享主存带宽另需时间，它们不能被这两项吸收。设四阶段时间分别为 8、3、2、5 ms，独立资源且缓冲足够时，四块完成时间为 18+(4−1)×8=42 ms；完全串行为 4×18=72 ms。42 ms 是设定整数时间的流水预测，不是目标机器实测；若转换与 H2D 争用同一 PCIe 或主存资源，42 ms 可能不可达。\\\\n\\\\n对更多块或更大模型，端到端时间应由依赖图、资源下界和有限排空共同决定。若资源 r 每块承担 Q_r 字节、在该并发条件下可持续带宽为 B_r，则启动周期还必须满足 P≥Q_r/B_r；例如 CPU 转换和 DMA 共用主存时，两者的读写流量要合并。多 rank 或多模型加载时，可把每个 rank 的排队 q_r 和本地流水 L_r 放入同一完成时间 T_ready=max_r(q_r+L_r)+T_barrier，但前提是 barrier 之后才需要共同发布；各 rank 的字节服务时间不能简单相加替代本地流水。\\\\n\\\\n容量账按唯一物理对象统计。主机读缓冲、设备槽、转换工作区和未释放旧版本各有生存期；同一 backing 的别名只计一次，共享只读页只计一次，确实复制的两份分别计。池的 reserved 已经包含其中 used 时不能再次相加；在途但尚未发布的对象必须占用容量。新旧模型并存、取消排空和失败重试都会出现在峰值中。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件变化后的保留、调整与放弃\\\\n\\\\n模型常驻且只冷启动一次时，复杂直接 I/O、注册缓存和深流水的准备成本可能难以摊销；频繁模型切换、多模型共享 SSD 或主存接近上限时，分块流水和可回收槽更重要。数据频繁复用且页缓存足够时，保留缓存路径可能更便宜；单遍大制品、缓存污染严重或需要应用精确控制驻留时，可比较直接 I/O 与有界块池。\\\\n\\\\nSSD 变快后，瓶颈可能移到 CPU 转换、页缓存刷新、锁页、PCIe 或设备消费；继续增加读取线程可能只增加主机驻留和队列。块太小增加提交、元数据、检查和尾块开销，块太大增加首块等待、过读和峰值；不存在脱离文件布局、设备并发、消费者粒度和尾延迟目标的通用最佳块大小。多模型环境下要让接近消费的 KV 或权重优先，不能让远期预取永久占满槽位。\\\\n\\\\nGPUDirect 类直通路径在平台、IOMMU、驱动和第三方设备都满足条件时才合法；若存储 IOPS、格式转换或设备 kernel 是瓶颈，去掉主机中转未必改善端到端时间。若目标是不可丢失的提交记录，应先满足持久性合同，再讨论页缓存、直接 I/O 或写合并。若对象是可重建 KV，允许丢弃和重新计算是一种恢复选择，但重算会争用 CPU/GPU，不能把缓存丢失当成零成本。\\\\n\\\\n## 诊断：竞争解释与区分实验\\\\n\\\\n先固定对象版本、有效字节、冷热状态、并发和完成边界，再让竞争解释给出不同预测。一次总时间测量通常同时改变了 cache、队列、CPU 和驻留，不能单独定位原因。\\\\n\\\\n| 观察 | 竞争解释 | 区分实验 | 反证后的修正 |\\\\n|---|---|---|---|\\\\n| 加载吞吐低 | IOPS 上限、设备带宽、CPU 提交、转换、页缓存污染或共享链路 | 固定有效字节，比较冷/热缓存；扫描块大小；记录实际读取字节、队列等待、CPU 时间和各阶段完成 | 增大块只增加等待而不增加有效字节时，撤回纯带宽解释 |\\\\n| 队列更深但吞吐不升 | 设备已饱和、CPU/PCIe 受限、槽不足或请求粒度过小 | 固定工作量，改变在途槽数并记录完成率和排队；保持块大小和缓存状态 | 完成率不升而等待上升，说明深度只增加排队；先找共享资源 |\\\\n| 小块很多但大块不更快 | 提交开销、过读、尾块、转换或消费者粒度 | 在相同有效字节下比较多档块大小；分别记录首块、稳态和尾块时间 | 大块过读或尾延迟更差时，选择较小块或有界合并 |\\\\n| mmap 很快 | 页已驻留、文件在页缓存、只读共享或缺少冷访问 | 用冷缓存对照、独立进程和相同字节；记录缺页、实际存储字节和主存峰值 | 冷访问变慢时，不能把热映射速度当作存储能力 |\\\\n| 直接 I/O 变慢 | 对齐失败、回退、页缓存刷新、额外 staging 或队列不足 | 比较对齐/非对齐、干净/脏页缓存、单/多槽；记录短读和错误返回 | 出现刷新或回退时，路径成本不能只按设备带宽估 |\\\\n| 某些块发布后内容混杂 | 完成顺序被误当提交顺序、旧 completion 释放新 lease、部分范围被当成完整 | 打乱完成顺序；注入旧代次、重复完成和缺失范围；按对象和范围重取 | 旧事件只能结算旧责任；完整范围与错误状态齐备前不得发布 |\\\\n| 直通路径没有收益 | 平台不支持、注册成本、存储瓶颈、转换瓶颈或主机内存不是瓶颈 | 核实注册与映射条件；比较主机内存流量、单块延迟和关闭直通后的路径 | 存储或转换仍占主导时，不能把直通当作通用加速 |\\\\n| 写入返回但恢复后缺失 | 页缓存未写回、文件系统或设备缓存、提交点不清、旧版本被提前删除 | 在明确故障点检查同步、清单发布和旧读者；区分缓存丢失与持久状态丢失 | 只有持久性合同满足后才报告可恢复；可重算缓存另行处理 |\\\\n\\\\n负对照应触发实质错误：把串行工作量当作流水完成时间、给 9 ms 生存期和 4 ms 周期只配 2 个槽、忽略代次只按偏移拼接范围、或在 DMA 完成前启动依赖 kernel，都应被检查拒绝。若系统只在全设备同步后恢复正常，不能由此唯一定位缺的是哪条依赖边，因为同步同时改变了多个候选关系。\\\\n\\\\n## 检查与证据范围\\\\n\\\\n配套 `tools/check_k_hw_012_full.py` 是 Python 标准库 CPU 整数/事件模型，不执行文件 I/O、块设备、CUDA、PCIe 或 GPUDirect。它用独立递推和闭式公式核对有限块流水，覆盖 N=0、零持续时间和不同块数；用槽区间重叠核对固定周期下的最少槽数，并实际构造少一个槽的覆盖错误；用范围并集核对部分完成、乱序完成、重复范围、空载荷和旧代次隔离；用 GPUDirect 的“DMA 对 CPU 线程完成后才允许依赖 kernel”核对提前启动与提前 unpin。负对照包括串行时间冒充流水、槽数不足、忽略代次和主机读回代替设备顺序，脚本要求这些错误被明确检出。\\\\n\\\\n这些检查只证明所述有限模型中的代数、区间和状态关系，不证明真实 SSD、文件系统、页缓存行为、O_DIRECT 对齐、DMA 可见性、GPU kernel 重叠、服务尾延迟或 Agent 使用效果。交付脚本尚待协调者在隔离环境执行并保存 stdout、stderr 和返回码；本章不声称已经执行，也不把设定时间当成目标机器测量。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-GPUDIRECT：NVIDIA GPUDirect RDMA — CUDA 12.8.0](../sources/S-GPUDIRECT.md)：固定文档 §1–2 说明外部 DMA
